ग: ग The third consonant of the Nagri alphabet, the letter G.

ग mfn. (-गः-गा-गं) Who or what goes, used chiefly in composition: as अध्वगः a traveller, who goes a road; अपगा what goes down, (a river, &c.) 	 m. (-गः) 	 1. A name of the deity GANESHA. 	 2. A Gand-harba or celestial musician. 	 f. (-गा) A song. 	 n. (-गं) Song, singing. E. गम् to go or गै to sing, affix ड, fem. affix टाप्.
गगण: गगण n. (-णं) Sky, atmosphere, heaven.  E. गम् to go. Unadi affix युच् and the radical final changed to ग; the word and its derivatives are also sometimes read गगन.
गगणध्वज: गगणध्वज (-जः) 1. A cloud. 	 2. The sun.  E. गगण the sky, and ध्वज a stand-ard or symbol.
गगणाध्वग: गगणाध्वग m. (-गः) 	 1. The sun. 	 2. A planet. 	 3. A heavenly spirit. E. गगण the sky, अध्वन् a road, and ग who goes.
गगणपुष्प: गगणपुष्प m. (-ष्पः) A flower in the sky. i. e. an impossibility.  E. गगण, and पुष्प a flower; alse गगणकुसुम, &c.
गगणविहारिन्: गगणविहारिन् mfn. (-री-रिणी-रि) Sporting in heaven. 	 m. (-री) 	 1. The sun. 2. A heavenly luminary. 	 3. A divinity or celestial being,  E. गगण, and विहारिन् who sports.
गगणसद्: गगणसद् mf. (-सत् or -सद्) Going in the air. 	 m. (-सद्) A celestial being. E. गगण, and षद् to go, क्विप् aff.
गगणस्थ: गगणस्थ mfn. (-स्थः-स्था-स्थं) Situated in the sky.  E. गगण and स्थ what stays in; also गगणस्थित, &c.
गगणस्पर्शन: गगणस्पर्शन m. (-नः) Air, wind.  E. गगण, and स्पर्शन who touches.
गगणाग्र: गगणाग्र n. (-ग्रं) The highest heavens, the summit or highest part of heaven.  E. गगण, and अग्र end.
गगणेचर: गगणेचर m. (-रः) 	 1. A planet 2. An asterism. 	 3. A heavenly spirit. E. गगणे in the sky, चर who goes.
गगणोल्मुक: गगणोल्मुक m. (-कः) The planet Mars.  E. गगण the sky, and उल्मुका a torch or coal.
गग्घ: गग्घ r. 1st cl. (गग्घति) To laugh, to laugh at or deride: see घग्घ.
गङ्गा: गङ्गा f. (-ङ्गा) The river Ganges, or its personification as a goddess. E. गम् to go, Unadi affix गन्, or गां the accusative of गो the earth, and ग who goes, form irr.
गङ्गाका: गङ्गाका f. (-का) The river Ganges.  E. कन् added to the preceding; also read गङ्गका.
गङ्गाक्षेत्र: गङ्गाक्षेत्र n. (-त्रं) The river Ganges, and two Krosh on either of its banks.  E. गङ्गा, and क्षेत्र holy place; all dying within such limits going to heaven, whatever their crimes.
गङ्गाचिल्ली: गङ्गाचिल्ली f. (-ल्ली) The black headed gull, (Larus ridibundus.)  E. गङ्गा the Ganges, and चिल्ली a kite, considered by the Hindus as a species of that bird; the Gangetic kite.
गङ्गाज: गङ्गाज m. (-जः) 	 1. A name of BHISHMA. 	 2. A name of the deity KARTI-KEYA.  E. गङ्गा the river goddess, and ज born; the son of GANGA.
गङ्गाजल: गङ्गाजल n. (-लः) The water of the Ganga.  E. गङ्गा, and जल water.
गङ्गाटेय: गङ्गाटेय mfn. (-यः-यी-यं) Going in or to the Ganges. 	 m. (-यः) A shrimp or prawn; also गलाविल.  E. गङ्गा the river, and अट् to go, अच् affix, गङ्गाट, and ढक् added.
गङ्गाद्बार: गङ्गाद्बार n. (-रं) The place where the Ganga enters the plains; also Haridwar.  E. गङ्गा, and द्वार gate.
गङ्गातीर: गङ्गातीर n. (-रं) The bank of the Ganga.  E. गङ्गा, and तीर a bank.
गङ्गाधर: गङ्गाधर m. (-रः) 	 1. An epithet of SIVA. 	 2. The ocean.  E. गङ्गा the Ganges, and धर who possesses or receives; according to the legend, the Ganges in its descent first alighted on the head of SIVA, and con-tinued for some period entangled in his hair.
गङ्गापार: गङ्गापार n. (-रं) The bank of the Ganges.  E. गङ्गा, and पार the bank.
गङ्गापुत्र: गङ्गापुत्र m. (-त्रः) 	 1. BHISHMA. 	 2. A man of a mixed and vile caste, em-ployed to remove dead bodies. 	 3. A Brahman who conducts the ceremonies of pilgrimage at some places on the Ganges, especially at Benares.  E. गङ्गा, and पुत्र a son.
गङ्गामध्य: गङ्गामध्य n. (-ध्यं) The bed or stream of the Ganges.  E. गङ्गा, and मध्य centre.
गङ्गाम्बु: गङ्गाम्बु n. (-म्बु) 	 1. Pure rain water, such as falls in Aswin. 	 2. Ganges water.  E. गङ्गा, and अम्बु water.
गङ्गायात्रा: गङ्गायात्रा f. (-त्रा) 	 1. Pilgrimage to the Ganga. 	 2. Carrying a sick per-son to the river side to die there.  E. गङ्गा, and यात्रा going.
गङ्गासुत: गङ्गासुत m. (-तः) 	 1. A name of KARTIKEYA. 	 2. A name of the hero BHISHMA: see गङ्गाज.  E. गङ्गा, and सुत a son; the son of GANGA.
गङ्गिका: गङ्गिका f. (-का) The Ganges.  E. गङ्गा, and कन् affix fem. from; also गङ्गका, and गङ्गाका.
गङ्गीभूत: गङ्गीभूत mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Become as the Ganges, as sacred, &c.  E. गङ्गा, and भूत become, च्वि augment.
गच्छ: गच्छ m. (-च्छः) A tree.  E. गम् to go, and स Unadi affix, what goes or grows; also अगच्छ.
गच्छत्: गच्छत् mfn. (-च्छन्-च्छन्ती-च्छत्) Going.  E. गम् to go, शतृ aff.
गज: गज r. 1st cl. (गजति) To be drunk, to be confused or inebriated; r. 1st and 10th cls. (गजति, गजयति) also (इ) गजि r. 1st cl. (गञ्जति) To sound.

गज m. (-जः) 	 1. An elephant. 	 2. A measure of length, the Gaz, a yard, a measure of two cubits. 	 3. A mound of earth sloping on both sides, on which a house may be created. 	 4. A small hole in the ground for a fire, over which to prepare medicines.  E. गज् to sound, to roar, affix अच्.
गजकन्द: गजकन्द m. (-न्दः) A large esculent root, a sort of arum.  E. गज, and कन्द root.
गजकूर्माशिन्: गजकूर्म्माशिन् m. (-शी) A name of GARURA the bird and vehicle of VISHNU.  E. गज an elephant, कूर्म्म a tortoise, and अशिन् who eats; alluding to a legend of his swallowing both animals whilst engaged in a contest with each other.
गजकूर्म्माशिन्: गजकूर्म्माशिन् m. (-शी) A name of GARURA the bird and vehicle of VISHNU.  E. गज an elephant, कूर्म्म a tortoise, and अशिन् who eats; alluding to a legend of his swallowing both animals whilst engaged in a contest with each other.
गजविर्भट: गजविर्भट mf. (-टः-टा) A kind of cucumber, (Cucumis Madraspatanus.)
गजच्छाया: गजच्छाया f. (-या) A portion of time proper for a Sraddha,  E. गज, and छाया shadow.
गजढक्का: गजढक्का f. (-क्का) A kettle-drum carried on an elephant.  E. गज an ele-phant, and ढक्का a large drum.
गजता: गजता f. (-ता) A multitude of elephants.  E. गज an elephant, तल् aff.
गजदघ्न: गजदघ्न mfn. (-घ्नः-घ्नी-घ्नं) As high or tall as an elephant  E. गज, and दघ्नच् aff.
गजदन्त: गजदन्त m. (-न्तः) 	 1. A name of GANESHA. 	 2. Ivory, the elephant's tooth. 3. A bracket or pin projecting from the wall.  E. गज a elephant, and दन्त a tooth; GANESHA is represented with an elephant's head.
गजदान: गजदान n. (-नं) The liquor exuding from an elephant's temples.  E. गज and दान the same.
गजद्वयस: गजद्वयस mfn. (-सः-सी-सं) As high as an elephant.  E. गज, and द्वयसच् aff.
गजपति: गजपति m. (-तिः) 	 1. A large state elephant. 	 2. A king.  E. गज, and पति a master.
गजपिप्पली: गजपिप्पली f. (-ली) A plant bearing a seed which resembles pepper, (Poth-os officinalis)  E. गज an elephant, and पिप्पली long pepper; consi-dered to be a large species of pepper: see similar names, as करि-पिप्पली, इभकणा, &c.
गजपुङ्गव: गजपुङ्गव m. (-वः) A large and excellent elephant.  E. गज, and पुङ्गव implying eminence.
गजपुट: गजपुट m. (-टः) A small hollow for a fire, over which to prepare medi-cal decoctions, extracts, &c.  E. गज, and पुट a hollow.
गजप्रिया: गजप्रिया f. (-या) The gum olibanum tree, (Boswellia serrata.)  E. गज an elephant, and प्रिय beloved; also वल्लकी.
गजबन्धनी: गजबन्धनी f. (-नी) A post to which an elephant is bound.  E. गज, and बन्धन a binding.
गजभक्षक: गजभक्षक m. (-कः) The sacred fig tree.  E. गज, and भक्षक eater; the young branches of the Pipal being the elephant's favourite food.
गजभक्षा: गजभक्षा f. (-क्षा) The gum olibanum tree: see गजप्रिय.  E. गज an ele-phant and भक्षा food; also गजभक्ष्या.
गजमण्डलिका: गजमण्डलिका f. (-का) A ring or circle of elephants surrounding a car. &c.  E. गज, मण्डल a circle, कन् affix fem. form.
गजमाचल: गजमाचल m. (-लः) A lion.  E. गज an elephant, मा fortune, and चल what goes: the destroyer of the elephant.
गजमात्र: गजमात्र mfn. (-त्रः-त्री-त्रं) As tall as an elephant.  E. गज, and मात्रच् aff.
गजमुक्ता: गजमुक्ता f. (-क्ता) A pearl, supposed to be found in the head of an ele-phant.  E. गज, and मुक्ता a pearl.
गजमोटन: गजमोटन m. (-नः) A lion.  E. गज an elephant, मुट् to run away, in the causal from, affix ल्युट्; or with मुच् to go, गजमोचन as it is some-times read.
गजयूथ: गजयूथ m. (-थः) A herd of elephants.  E. गज, and यूथ a herd.
गजवदन: गजवदन m. (-नः) A name of GANESHA, who is represented always with the head of an elephant.  E. गज. and वदन a face.
गजव्रज: गजव्रज mfn. (-जः-जा-जं) Who walks like an elephant. 	 n. (-जं) 	 1. A troop of elephants. 2, The pace of an elephant.  E. गज, and व्रज a number or going, who goes, &c.
गजसाह्वय: गजसाह्वय n. (-यं) A famous city, Hastinapur the capital of the KuRUS. E. गज, स for सम् with, and आह्वय an appellation; named from its elephants; also गजाह्व, &c.
गजाग्रणी: गजाग्रणी m. (-णी) The elephant of INDRA.  E. गज and अग्रणी pre-eminent.
गजाजीव: गजाजीव m. (-वः) An elephant keeper or driver.  E. गज and आजीव who lives; who gets his livelihood by elephants.
गजानन: गजानन m. (-नः) The deity GANESHA.  E. गज an elephant, and आनन a face; see गजवदन.
गजारि: गजारि m. (-रिः) 	 1. A lion. 	 2. A particular tree.  E. गज and अरि a foe.
गजारूढ: गजारूढ mfn. (-ढः-ढा-ढं) Mounted or riding on an elephant.  E. गज and and आरूढ mounted.
गजाशन: गजाशन m. (-नः) The religious fig tree. 	 f. (-ना) 	 1. Hemp, (Cannabis sativa.) 	 2. The gum olibanum tree. 	 3. The root of a lotus.  E. गज and अशन food; the food of elephants.
गजास्य: गजास्य m. (-स्यः) GANESHA: see गजानन.  E. गज an elephant, and आस्य a face.
गजाह्व: गजाह्व n. (-ह्वं) The city Hastinapur. 	 f. (-ह्वा) A plant: see गजपिप्पली. E. गज, and आह्वा a name: see गजसाह्वय.
गजाह्वय: गजाह्वय n. (-यं) Hastinapur, the ancient Dehli: see the preceding.
गजेन्द्र: गजेन्द्र m. (-न्द्रः) 	 1. A large and excellent elephant. 	 2. INDRA'S elephant E. गज, and इन्द्र chief.
गजोषणा: गजोषणा f. (-णा) A short of pepper: see गजपिप्पली.  E. गज, and उषणा pepper.
गञ्ज: गञ्ज mfn. subst. (-ञ्जः-ञ्जा-ञ्जं) A mine, a jewel mine mn. (-ञ्जः-ञ्जं) 	 1. A cow-house or station of cowherds. 	 2. A treasury, a jewel room, the place where plate, &c. is preserved. 	 3. A mart, a place where grain, &c. is stored for sale. 	 m. (-ञ्जः) Disrespect, contempt. 	 f. (ञ्जा) 1. A tavern. 	 2. A drinking vessel. 	 3. A hut, a hovel, the abode of low people. 	 4. The Gunja or Ratti, (Abrus precatorious:) see गुञ्जा. E. गजि to sound, अच् affix; fem. affix टाप्.
गञ्चिका: गञ्चिका f. (-का) A tavern.  E. कन् added to the preceding.
गड: गड r. 1st cl. (गडति) To distil or drop, to run as a liquid; also, गल (इ) गडि r. 1st cl. (गण्डति) To affect the cheek, to be rough as the cheek, (obsolete.)

गड m. (-डः) 	 1. A kind of fish, the young of the Ophiocephaluslata, Ham. 	 2. Another species, (Cyprinus garra. Ham.) see गल. 	 3. An impediment, an obstacle. 	 4. A screen, a covering, a fence. 	 5. A moat, a ditch. 	 6. A country, part of Malwa, Gerha or Gera Men-dela.  E. गड्. to drop, affix अच्.
गडक: गडक m. (-कः) A kind of fish: see the last.  E. गड्. to drop, affix क्वुन्.
गडयन्त: गडयन्त m. (-न्तः) A cloud.  E. गड् to drop (water), Unadi affix झच् and अय substituded for the penultimate.
गडलवण: गडलवण n. (-णं) Rock or fossile salt, especially that found in the dis-trict of Sambhar in the province of Ajmere.  E. गड a country, and लवण salt.
गडि: गडि m. (-डिः) 	 1. A steer. 	 2. A lazy ox.  E. गड् to drop, इन् aff.
गडु: गडु mfn. (-डुः-डुः-डु) Crooked, humpbacked, &c. 	 m. (-डुः) 	 1. A hump on the back. 	 2. Goitre or Bronchocele. 	 3. A humpbacked man. 	 4. A Javelin, a spear. 	 5. An earth-worm. 6, A water pot.  E. गड् to drop, Unadi affix उ.
गडुक: गडुक n. (-कं) 	 1. A water pot. 	 2. A finger ring.  E. कन् added to the last.
गडुकण्ठ: गडुकण्ठ mfn. (-ण्ठः-ण्ठी-ण्ठं) Having a goitre.  E. गडु, and कण्ठ the throat.
गडुर: गडुर mfn. (-रः-रा-रं) Crooked, bent, humpbacked.  E. गडु a hump, and र substituted for लः see the next.
गडुल: गडुल mfn. (-लः-ला-लं) Crooked, humpbacked.  E. गडु hump, and लच् affix; also गडुर.
गडेर: गडेर m. (-रः) A cloud.  E. गड् to drop (water), and एरक् Unadi aff.
गडोत्थ: गडोत्थ n. (-त्थं) Fossile salt.  E. गड the country, and उत्थ produced.
गडोल: गडोल m. (-लः) 	 1. A mouthful. 	 2. Raw sugar.  E. गड् to drop, ओलच् Unadi affix; also गण्डोल.
गड्डरिका: गड्डरिका f. (-का) 	 1. A sudden rush of water of which the source is unknown. 	 2. A single ewe preceding a flock of sheep.
गड्डुक: गड्डुक m. (-कः) A golden vase.  E. गड् to sprinkle, डुक Unadi affix; also गड्डूक and occasionally कडूक.
गड्डूक: गड्डूक m. (-कः) A golden water vessel: see the preceding.
गण: गण r. 10th cl. (गणयति) To count, to reckon up by: number, to calculate.

गण m. (-णः) 	 1. A flock, a multitude, a troop, a tribe or class, &c. 	 2. A body of troops equal to three Gulmas or twenty-seven chariots and as many elephants, eighty-one horses, and 135 foot. 	 3. Troops of inferior deities considered as SIVA'S attendants, and under the especial superintendance of GANESHA. 	 4. A name of GANESHA. 	 5. A number (in arithmetic.) 	 6. A kind of perfume, commonly Chor. 7. A sect in philosophy or religion. 	 8. A conjugation, a class or radicals. 	 2. Series of asterisms which are classed under three heads human, infernal, and divine.  E. गण् to count to reckon, affix अच्.
गणक: गणक m. (-कः) 	 1. An astrologer, a calculator of nativities. &c. 	 2. An arithmetician. 	 f. (-की) The wife of an astrologer.  E. गण् to calcul-ate, affix क्वुन्, fem. affix ङीष्.
गणकार: गणकार m. (-रः) 	 1. A name of BHIMASENA. 	 2. A classifier, one who arranges into classes.  E. गण a troop, and कार who forms.
गणचक्रक: गणचक्रक n. (-कं) A dinner in common by a party of virtuous men. E. गण a number, चक्र a wheel or circle, and कन् aff.
गणता: गणता f. (-ता) 	 1. Classification. 	 2. Multitude, assemblage. 	 3. Following a part or fraction. 	 4. Arithmetic.  E. गण a class, तल् affix; also with त्व, गणत्वं.
गणदीक्षा: गणदीक्षा f. (-क्षा) 	 1. Initiation of a particular kind in which GANESA is especially worshipped. 	 2. Initiation of a number or class. 	 3. Per-formance of religious rites for a number of persons.  E. गण, and दीक्षा a religious rite.
गणदीक्षिन्: गणदीक्षिन् m. (-क्षी) 	 1. A priest who officiates for various castes and people. 	 2. One who has been initiated into the worship of GANESHA. E. गण, दीक्षा a rite, and इनि aff.
गणदेवता: गणदेवता f. (-ता) A deity of a class, as an Aditya a Vasu, a Rudra, &c. E. गण, and देवता a divinity.
गणद्रव्य: गणद्रव्य n. (-व्यं) 	 1. Public property, common stock. 	 2. A variety of articles.  E. गण a class, and द्रव्य thing.
गणधर: गणधर m. (-रः) 	 1. The head of a class or number, the teacher of a school. 	 2. A title of the first diciples of the Jaina Mahavira. E. गण a class, and धर who holds.
गणन: गणन nf. (-नं-ना) 	 1. Counting, enumerating. 	 2. Arithmetic.  E. गण् to count, युच् aff.
गणनाथ: गणनाथ m. (-थः) A name of GANESHA.  E. गण, and नाथ lord.
गणनायक: गणनायक m. (-कः) A name of GANESHA. 	 f. (-यिका) A name of DURGA. E. गण, and नायक a leader; see गणेश.
गणनीय: गणनीय mfn. (-यः-यी-यं) 	 1. Numerable, to be counted or reckoned. 	 2. To be classed.  E. गण् to count, and अनीयर् aff.
गणपति: गणपति m. (-तिः) GANESHA.  E. गण् and पति lord: see गणेश.
गणपर्वत: गणपर्व्वत m. (-तः) The fabulous mountain Kailasha.  E. गण SIVA'S attend-ant demigods, and पर्व्वत a mountain; this mountain being the residence of the Kinnaras, Yakshas, and other subordinate deities.
गणपर्व्वत: गणपर्व्वत m. (-तः) The fabulous mountain Kailasha.  E. गण SIVA'S attend-ant demigods, and पर्व्वत a mountain; this mountain being the residence of the Kinnaras, Yakshas, and other subordinate deities.
गणपीठक: गणपीठक n. (-कं) The breast or bosom.  E. गण the aggregate, (of quali-ties,) and पीठक a seat.
गणरात्र: गणरात्र n. (-त्रं) A multitude of nights.  E. गण, and रात्र night.
गणरूप: गणरूप m. (-पः) Swallow wort, (Colotropis gigantea;) also अर्क.  E. गण a number, and रूप form, multiform.
गणरूपिन्: गणरूपिन् m. (-पी) Swallow wort, the white sort: see the preceding.
गणवतीसुत: गणवतीसुत m. (-तः) The name of a sage and physician, also called DHAN-WANTARI or KASIRAJA.  E. गणवती a proper name, and सुत a son, the son of GANAVATI.
गणहासक: गणहासक m. (-कः) Chor, a species of perfume,  E. गण many, and हासक what causes to smile, what de-lights.
गणाग्रणी: गणाग्रणी m. (-णीः) A name of GANESHA.  E. गण the troops of deities, and अग्रणी principal.
गणाचल: गणाचल m. (-लः) The mountain Kailasha.  E. गण, and अचल a mountain, the residence of the GANAS or troops of demi-gods.
गणाधिप: गणाधिप m. (-पः) 	 1. A name of GANESHA. 	 2. A title of SIVA. 	 3. The chief of a troop of soldiers, of a class of diciples, of a body of men or animals, &c.  E. गण, and अधिप Master; also गणाधिपति, and other similar epithets: see गणेश.
गणान्न: गणान्न n. (-न्नं) A mess, food prepared for a number of Persons in com-mon.  E. गण and अन्न food.
गणाभ्यन्तर: गणाभ्यन्तर mfn. (-रः-रा-रं) One of a troop or number. 	 m. (-रः) A member of a religious convent or association.  E. गण, and अभ्यन्तर included गणि f. (-णिः) Counting, enumerating  E. गण् to count, इञ् aff.
गणिका: गणिका f. (-का) 	 1. A courtezan, a harlot. 	 2. A sort of Jasmin. (J. auriculatum.) 	 3. A tree, commonly Ganiyari, (Premnaspinosa.) 4. A female elephant. 	 5. Counting, enumerating.  E. गण to reckon, &c. ण्वुल् aff.
गणिकारिका: गणिकारिका f. (-का) The name of a small tree with a very fetid leaf, commonly called Ganiyari, the wood of which is used in attrition, for the purpose of producing flame, (Premna spinosa.)  E. कन् added to गणिकारी.
गणिकारी: गणिकारी f. (-री) The name of a tree: see the preceding.
गणित: गणित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Numbered, counted, reckoned, calculated. 	 n. (-तं) 1. The science of computation, comprising arithmetic, algebra, and geometry, distinguished as पाटीगणितं, वीजगणितं and रेखागणितं. 	 2. Calculating, numbering.  E. गण to count, affix क्त.
गणितव्य: गणितव्य mfn. (-व्यः-व्या-व्यं) 	 1. To be counted or numbered. 	 2. To be cal-culated.  E. गण and तव्य aff.
गणिपिटका: गणिपिटका f. (-का) A division of science peculiar to the Jainas.
गणीभूत: गणीभूत mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 	 1. Included in any class or troop. 	 2. Calculated. E. गण, and भूत become, with च्वि augment.
गणेय: गणेय mfn. (-यः-यी-यं) Numberable, calculable, what may be reckoned or counted.  E. गण to count, and यत् affix, form irr. see गण्य.
गणेरु: गणेरु m. (-रुः) A plant, (Pterospermum acerifolium, &c.) see कर्णिकार. f. (-रुः) 	 1. A harlot, a whore. 	 2. A female elephant.  E. गण a number, ईर्, to go, &c. affix उ.
गणेरुका: गणेरुका f. (-का) A bawd, a procuress.  E. कन् added to the pre-ceding.
गणेश: गणेश m. (-शः) 	 1. A name of SIVA. 	 2. GANESA, the son of SIVA and PARVATI; he is the deity of wisdom, and remover of obstacles, whence in the commencement of all undertakings, the opening of all compositions. &c. he receives the reverential homage of the Hindus. He is represented as a short fat man with the head of an elephant; and the present appellation, with other similar compounds, alludes to his office as chief of the various classes of subordinate gods, who are regarded as SIVA'S attendants.  E. गण a troop or class (of deities attendant upon SIVA,) and ईश lord or master.
गणेशकुसुम: गणेशकुसुम m. (-मः) A shrub, Oleander with red flowers.  E. गणेश and कुसुम a flower.
गणेशपूजा: गणेशपूजा f. (-जा) Worship of GANESA.  E. गणेश and पूजा worship.
गणेशभूषण: गणेशभूषण n. (-णं) Red lead.  E. गणेश and भूषण ornament.
गणोत्साह: गणोत्साह m. (-हः) A rhinoceros.  E. गण a herd, and उत्साह toil.
गण्ड: गण्ड m. (-ण्डः) 	 1. A cheek, the whole side of the face including the tem-ple. 	 2. An elephant's temple or cheek. 	 3. A boil, a pimple. 	 4. A mark, a spot. 	 5. A bubble. 	 6. A knot. 	 7. A rhinoceros: (see गण्डक) 	 8. Part of a horse's trappings, a stud or button fixed as an orna-ment upon the harness. 	 9. A hero. 	 10. The abrupt interchange of question and answer, as one of the characteristics of the dramatic composition called Vithi. 	 11. The tenth Yoga, or one of the twenty-seven portions of a circle on the plane of the ecliptic: see योग. 	 12. An astronomical period.  E. गडि to affect the cheek, अच् affix, or गम् to go, ड Unadi aff.
गण्डक: गण्डक m. (-कः) 	 1. A rhinoceros. 	 2. A mode of reckoning by fours. 	 3. An obstacle or impediment. 	 4. Separation, disjunction. 	 5. Astrologi-cal science or a part of it. 	 f. (-की) The name of a river in the north of India, the Gandaki. 	 f. (-का) A lump, a ball.  E. गडि to affect the cheek, &c ण्वुल् affix, fem. affix ङीप्.
गण्डकारी: गण्डकारी f. (-री) A sensitive plant, (Mimosa pudica.)  E. गण्ड a boil, and कारी what occasions.
गण्डकाली: गण्डकाली f. (-ली) See the preceding.  E. गण्ड a knot, and काली black; black with many joints and knots.
गण्डकुसुम: गण्डकुसुम n. (-मं) The juice that exudes from the elephant's temples in time of rut.  E. गण्ड an elephant's temples, and कुसुम a flower, from its supposed fragrance.
गण्डकूप: गण्डकूप m. (-पः) The peak or summit of a mountain.
गण्डगात्र: गण्डगात्र n. (-त्रं) fruit, custard apple, (Annona squamosa)  E. गण्ड a boil, and गात्र a body; the inside being compared to purulent pustules.
गण्डफलक: गण्डफलक n. (-कं) The cheek.  E. गण्ड and फलक a layer.
गण्डमाला: गण्डमाला f. (-ला) Inflammation of the glands of the neck, &c.  E. गण्ड a boil. and माला a necklace.
गण्डमालिन्: गण्डमालिन् mfn. (-ली-लिनी-लि) Having the glands of the neck inflamed. E. इनि added to the last.
गण्डशैल: गण्डशैल m. (-लः) 	 1. A rock or rocky fragment fallen from a height thrown down by an earthquake, a storm, &c. 	 2. The forehead.  E. गण्ड a cheek, and शैल a rock, the cheek of the mountain, or in the second instance, vice-versa, the mountain as it were of the cheek or face.
गण्डस्थल: गण्डस्थल nf. (-लः-ली) The cheek.  E. गण्ड and स्थल place.
गण्डाङ्ग: गण्डाङ्ग m. (-ङ्गः) A rhinoceros.  E. गण्ड a stud, and अङ्ग a body; from the studded appearance of his hide.
गण्डाली: गण्डाली f. (-ली) A bent grass with white blossoms, a white sort of Durva, (Agrostis linearis.)  E. गण्ड a boil, अल् to be adequate to or fit for, affixes अण् and ङीष्.
गण्डि: गण्डि m. (-ण्डिः) 	 1. Goitre or Bronchocele. 	 2. The trunk of a tree. E. गण्डि to affect the cheek, &c. Unadi affix इन्.
गण्डीर: गण्डीर m. (-रः) 	 1. A kind of potherb, described as growing in watery ground, and according to some, a species of cucumber. 	 2. A hero, a champion. 	 f. (-री) A milky plant, (Euphorbia.)  E. गडि to affect a part. &c. इरन् aff.
गण्डु: गण्डु mf. (-ण्डुः) A pillow. 	 f. (-ण्डूः) A knot or joint.  E. गडि to sup-port the cheek, Unadi affix उ.
गण्डूपद: गण्डूपद m. (-दः) An earth-worm. 	 f. (-दी) A small or female worm. E. गण्डू a knot, and पद a foot.
गण्डूपदभव: गण्डूपदभव m. (-वः) Lead.  E. गण्डूपद a worm, and भव produced.
गण्डूष: गण्डूष mf. (-षः-षा) 	 1. A mouthful. 	 2. A handful. 	 3. A handful of water, &c. held in the hollowed palm of the hand for rincing the mouth, &c. 	 4. Filling the mouth, rincing it, &c. 	 5. The tip of an elephant's trunk.  E. गड् to drop, ऊषण् Unadi affix and नुम् inserted.
गण्डोल: गण्डोल m. (-लः) 	 1. Raw sugar. 	 2. A mouthful.  E. गड् to drop, or गडि to affect the cheek, ओलच् affix; also गडोल  E. गण् to count, यत् aff.
गण्य: गण्य mfn. (-ण्यः-ण्या-ण्यं) To be counted or calculated.  E. गण् to count, affix of the future participle यत्; also irregularly गणेय.
गत: गत mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 	 1. Gone. 	 2. Known, understood. 	 3. Obtained, gained. 	 4. Lost. 	 n. (-तं) 	 1. Going, motion. 	 2. Any thing past or done, an event.  E. गम् to go, in the participle past.
गतकाल: गतकाल n. (-लं) Time past.  E. गत, and काल time.
गतक्लम: गतक्लम mfn. (-मः-मा-मं) Rested, refreshed.  E. गत and क्लम fatigue.
गतचेतन: गतचेतन mfn. (-नः-ना-नं) Senseless. swooned.  E. गत and चेतना conscious-ness.
गतज्वर: गतज्वर mfn. (-रः-रा-रं) Well, recovered, free from fever or sickness. E. गत and ज्वर fever.
गततोयद: गततोयद mfn. (-दः-दा-दं) Cloudless, cleared up, fair.  E. गत, and तोयद a cloud.
गतप्रत्यागत: गतप्रत्यागत mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Returned, come back again after having gone away.  E. गत and प्रत्यागत come back.
गतदिन: गतदिन n. (-नं) Yesterday.  E. गत and दिन day; also गतदिवसं.
गतधृति: गतधृति mfn. (-तिः-तिः-ति) Agitated, discomposed, unsteady.  E. गत and धृति firmness.
गतनासिक: गतनासिक mfn. (-कः-का-कं) Noseless.  E. गत gone, lost, and नासिका the nose.
गतमाय: गतमाय mfn. (-यः-या-यं) 	 1. Reformed, without deceit. 	 2. Cruel without compassion.  E. गत and माया deceit.
गतलक्ष्मीक: गतलक्ष्मीक mfn. (-कः-का-कं) Unfortunate, suffering losses; so गतश्रीक.
गतबत्: गतबत् mfn. (-वान्-वती-वत्) 	 1. Going, passing. 	 2. Obtaining. 	 3. Falling into. 	 4. Feeling, entertaining.  E. गम and क्तवतु aff.
गतवित्त: गतवित्त mfn. (-त्तः-त्ता-त्तं) Beggared, impoverished.  E. गत and वित्त wealth.
गतविभव: गतविभव mfn. (-वः-वा-वं) Poor, indigent.  E. गत and विभव wealth.
गतव्यथ: गतव्यथ mfn. (-थः-था-थं) 	 1. Free from pain. 	 2. Unanxious.  E. गत and व्यथ pain.
गतशैशव: गतशैशव mfn. (-वः-वा-वं) Grown up, above eight years of age.  E. गत and शैशव infancy.
गतसङ्कल्प: गतसङ्कल्प mfn. (-ल्पः-ल्पा-ल्पं) Bereft of sense, foolish.  E. गत and सङ्कल्प purpose.
गतसङ्ग: गतसङ्ग mfn. (-ङ्गः-ङ्गा-ङ्गं) 	 1. Detached from, dissevered. 	 2. Adverse or indifferent to.  E. गत, and सङ्ग union.
गतसत्व: गतसत्व mfn. (-त्वः-त्वा-त्वं) 	 1. Base. 	 2. Lifeless, dead, &c.  E. गत, and सत्व being.
गतसन्नक: गतसन्नक m. (-कः) An elephant out of rut.
गताक्ष: गताक्ष mfn. (-क्षः-क्षा-क्षं) Blind, sightless.  E. गत gone, and अक्ष for अक्षि the eye.
गतागत: गतागत m. (-तं) 	 1. The flight of a bird backward and forward. 	 2. Going and coming, reiterated motion in general.  E. गत going, आगत coming.
गतानुगतिक: गतानुगतिक mfn. (-कः-की-कं) Following, imitative, doing as others do. E. गत, and अनुगतिक who goes after.
गतायुस्: गतायुस् mfn. (-युः-युः-युः) 	 1. Very old, infirm, decrepid, decayed. 	 2. Dead. E. गत, and आयुस् life.
गतार्तवा: गतार्त्तवा f. (-वा) 	 1. A woman past child-bearing. 	 2. A barren woman. E. गत, and आर्त्तवा a woman menstruating.
गतार्त्तवा: गतार्त्तवा f. (-वा) 	 1. A woman past child-bearing. 	 2. A barren woman. E. गत, and आर्त्तवा a woman menstruating.
गतार्थ: गतार्थ mfn. (-र्थः-र्था-र्थं) 	 1. Unmeaning, nonsensical. 	 2. Poor. 	 3. Void of an object.  E. गत, and अर्थ sense, &c.
गतासु: गतासु mfn. (-सुः-सुः-सु) Dead, expired.  E. गत, and असु breath.
गति: गति m. (-तिः) 	 1. Going, moving, motion in general. 	 2. March, proces-sion. 	 3. A road, a way, a path. 	 4. A period of life, as age, youth, &c. 	 5. An expedient, a means of success. 	 6. Knowledge, wisdom. 7. A sinus, a fistular sore. 	 8. Worldly vanity or wickedness. 	 9. Course of events, fate, fortune. 	 10. Resource, refuge, asylum. 	 11. The diurnal motion of a planet in its orbit, 12. State, mode of existence.  E. गम् to go, affix क्तिन्.
गतिक: गतिक n. (-कं) 	 1. Going, motion. 	 2. Refuge, asylum. 	 3. Course. 	 4. Con-dition.  E. कन् added to the preceding.
गतिला: गतिला f. (-ला) 	 1. A name of river, the Gatila. 	 2. Mutual separation. E. गम् to go, इल Unadi affix, and त substituted for the radical final.
गत्वर: गत्वर mfn. (-रः-री-रं) Going, moving, locomotive.  E. गम् to go affix क्वरप्.
गत्वा: गत्वा ind. Having gone, gone to or attained, &c.  E. गम् to go, क्त्वा aff.
गत्यून: गत्यून mfn. (-नः-ना-नं) 	 1. Impassable, difficult of access. 	 2. Desert. 	 3. Helpless.  E. गति and ऊन् defective.
गद: गद r. 10th cl. (गदति) To speak articulately. 	 2. To be sick. r. 10th cl. (गदयति) To thunder.

गद m. (-दः) 	 1. Disease, sickness. 	 2. Speech, speaking. 	 3. GADA the younger brother of KRISHNA. 	 f. (-दा) 	 1. A mace, a club. 	 2. Trum-pet flower, (Bigonia suave-olens.)  E. गद् to speak, &c. अच् aff.
गदयित्नु: गदयित्नु mfn. (-त्नुः-त्नुः-त्नु) 	 1. Loquacious, talkative, talking much or idly. 2. Libidinous, lustful, desirous. 	 m. (-त्नुः) A name of KANDARPA, the deity of love.  E. गद् to speak, Unadi affix इत्नुच्, and अय in-serted.
गदाख्य: गदाख्य n. (-ख्यं) A kind of Costus, (C. speciosus:) see कुष्ठ.
गदागद: गदागद m. (always dual -दौ) The two physicians of Swarga, the sons of ASWINI by SURYA.  E. गद disease in general, and अगद health.
गदाग्रज: गदाग्रज m. (-जः) A name of VISHNU or KRISHNA  E. गद, and अग्रज an elder brother.
गदाधर: गदाधर m. (-रः) A name of KRISHNA.  E. गदा E. club, and धर who holds; KRISHNA or VISHNU is represented holding a mace in one of his hands.
गदाभृत्: गदाभृत् m. (-भृत्) 	 1. A name of KRISHNA. 	 2. A mace or club bearer. 	 3. One who fights with a mace.  E. गदा a club, and भृत् who nourishes. see the preceding.
गदाम्बर: गदाम्बर m. (-रः) A cloud.  E. गद sound, अम्बर the sky.
गदाराति: गदाराति m. (-तिः) A drug, a medicament.  E. गद and अराति an enemy.
गदाह्व: गदाह्व n. (-ह्वं) A kind of grass, (Costus speciosus:) see कुष्ठ.  E. गद disease, and आह्वा a name; named by many of the same terms as disease: see व्याधि, &c. also गदाख्य, गदाह्वय, &c.
गदित: गदित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Spoken, said.  E. गद् to speak, क्त aff.
गदितवत्: गदितवत् mfn. (-वान्-वती-वत्) Saying, speaking, having spoken.  E. गद, and क्तवतु aff.
गदिन्: गदिन् m. (-दी) 	 1. A name of VISHNU. 	 2. A mace bearer. 	 3. One armed with a club. 	 4. A sick man.  E. गदा a mace, and इनि poss. aff.
गद्गद्: गद्गद् m. (-दः) Indistinct or convulsive utterance, as sobbing, &c.  E. गद् to speak, क्विप् affix, root repeated with अच्.
गद्गदध्वनि: गद्गदध्वनि m. (-निः) low inarticulate expression of joy or grief.  E. गद्गद inarticulate utterance. and ध्वनि sound.
गद्गदपद: गद्गदपद n. (-दं) Inarticulate speech.  E. गद्गद and पद a word.
गद्गदवाच्: गद्गदवाच् f. (-वाक्) Inarticulate or convulsive speech, interrupted by sob-bing, &c.  E. गद्गद, and वाच् speech.
गद्य: गद्य mfn. (-द्यः-द्या-द्यं) To be spoken or uttered. 	 n. (-द्यं) Prose  E. गद् to speak, affix यत्.
गद्यानक: गद्यानक n. (-कं) A weight either of sixty-four or forty-eight Rattis; also read गद्यालक.
गन्तव्य: गन्तव्य mfn. (-व्यः-व्या-व्यं) To be gone, to be gone to or attained.  E. गम, and तव्य aff.
गन्तु: गन्तु m. (-न्तुः) A traveller, a way-farer.  E. गम् to go, Unadi affix तुन्.
गन्तृ: गन्तृ mfn. (-न्ता-न्त्री-न्तृ) Who or what goes or moves.  E. गम् to go, तृच् aff.
गन्त्री: गन्त्री f. (-न्त्री) A cart or car drawn by oxen.  E. गम् to go, इन् affix, fem. affix ङीष्.
गन्त्रीरथ: गन्त्रीरथ m. (-थः) A cart.  E. गन्त्री a carriage drawn by oxen, and रथ a vehicle.
गन्ध: गन्ध r. 10th cl. (गन्धयते) 	 1. To injure, to hurt or kill. 	 2. To move, to go. 3. To ask or beg.

गर्भपातिन्: गर्भपातिन् mfn. (-ती-तिनी-ति) Producing abortion f. (-नी) A kind of potherb: see विशल्या. E. As in the last, affixes णिनि and ङीप्.
गर्भपोषण: गर्भपोषण n. (-णं) Gestation.  E. गर्भ, and पोषण nourishing.
गर्भरूप: गर्भरूप mfn. (-पः-पी-पं) A child, an infant.  E. गर्भ an embryo, and रूप form; also गर्भरूपकः.
गर्भवती: गर्भवती f. (-ती) A pregnant female.  E. गर्भ a fœtus, and मतुप् poss. aff.
गर्भशङ्कु: गर्भशङ्कु m. (-ङ्कुः) A kind of vectis or instrument for extracting the dead fœtus.  E. गर्भ and शङ्कु a probe.
गर्भशय्या: गर्भशय्या f. (-य्या) The uterus.  E. गर्भ, and शय्या a bed.
गर्भस्थ: गर्भस्थ mfn. (-स्थः-स्था-स्थं) 	 1. Situated in the womb. 	 2. Centrical, internal, within the centre of any thing.  E. गर्भ, and स्थ what abides.
गर्भस्राव: गर्भस्राव m. (-वः) Abortion, miscarriage.  E. गर्भ the embryo, and स्राव expulsion.
गर्भस्राविन्: गर्भस्राविन् mfn. (-वी-विणी-वि) Producing or occasioning abortion.  E. गर्भ, and स्राविन् what causes to issue.
गर्भागार: गर्भागार n. (-रं) 	 1. An inner and private room, the female apartments, the lying-in chamber. 	 2. The sanctuary of a temple. The chamber where the object of worship is placed.  E. गर्भ the fœtus, and आगार an abode, hence it is applied to the womb: see गर्भाशय.
गर्भाधान: गर्भाधान n. (-नं) A ceremony performed prior to conception.  E. गर्भ the embryo, and आधान taking, being supposed conductive to future impregnation.
गर्भाशय: गर्भाशय m. (-यः) The womb, the uterus.  E. गर्भ the embryo, and आशय asy-lum or abode.
गर्भाष्टम: गर्भाष्टम m. (-मः) The eighth month of uterine gestation. 	 2. The eighth year reckoning from conception.  E. गर्भ the fœtus, and अष्टम eighth.
गर्भिणी: गर्भिणी f. (-णी) 	 1. A pregnant woman. 	 2. A plant, (Asclepias rosea)  E. गर्भ embryo, and इनि poss. affix, fem. affix ङीप्.
गर्भिण्यवेक्षण: गर्भिण्यवेक्षण n. (-णं) Midwifery, attendance and care of pregnant women and new born infants.  E. गर्भिणी, and अवेक्षण care, looking to.
गर्भोपघातिनी: गर्भोपघातिनी f. (-नी) A cow (or female), miscarrying from going unseason-ably.  E. गर्भ the fœtus, उप intensitive preffix, हन् to destroy, affixes णिनि and ङीप्.
गर्मुटिका: गर्म्मुटिका f. (-का) A species of rice.
गर्म्मुटिका: गर्म्मुटिका f. (-का) A species of rice.
गर्मुत्: गर्म्मुत् f. (-र्म्मुत्) 	 1. A kind of grass. 	 2. Gold. 	 3. A reed.  E. गॄ to swallow, &c. Unadi affix उति, and म inserted.
गर्म्मुत्: गर्म्मुत् f. (-र्म्मुत्) 	 1. A kind of grass. 	 2. Gold. 	 3. A reed.  E. गॄ to swallow, &c. Unadi affix उति, and म inserted.
गर्व: गर्व्व r. 1st cl. (गर्व्वति) To be proud or haughty; also (ङ) गर्वङ् r. 10th cl. (गर्व्वयते) To grow proud.
गर्व्व m. (-र्व्वः) Pride, arrogance.  E. गर्व्व् to be proud, affix अच् or गॄ to swallow, &c. and व Unadi affix; this word is sometimes written गर्ब्ब.
गर्व्व: गर्व्व r. 1st cl. (गर्व्वति) To be proud or haughty; also (ङ) गर्वङ् r. 10th cl. (गर्व्वयते) To grow proud.
गर्व्व m. (-र्व्वः) Pride, arrogance.  E. गर्व्व् to be proud, affix अच् or गॄ to swallow, &c. and व Unadi affix; this word is sometimes written गर्ब्ब.
गर्वर: गर्व्वर mfn. (-रः-रा-रं) Proud, haughty, arrogant.  E. गॄ to reject, &c. Unadi affix खरच्.
गर्व्वर: गर्व्वर mfn. (-रः-रा-रं) Proud, haughty, arrogant.  E. गॄ to reject, &c. Unadi affix खरच्.
गर्वाट: गर्व्वाट m. (-टः) A watchman, a doorkeeper, a sort of village constable, a headborough or beadle.  E. गर्व्व pride, अट् to go, and अच् aff.
गर्व्वाट: गर्व्वाट m. (-टः) A watchman, a doorkeeper, a sort of village constable, a headborough or beadle.  E. गर्व्व pride, अट् to go, and अच् aff.
गर्वित: गर्व्वित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 	 1. Proud, haughty. 	 2. Conceited.  E. गर्व्व pride, and इतच् aff.
गर्व्वित: गर्व्वित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 	 1. Proud, haughty. 	 2. Conceited.  E. गर्व्व pride, and इतच् aff.
गर्ह: गर्ह r. 1st and 10th cls. (गर्हति-ते, गर्हयति) To blame, to censure to despise or contemn.
गर्हण: गर्हण n. (-णं) Censuring, censure, blame, reproach.  E. गर्ह् reprove, affix ल्युट्.
गर्हणीय: गर्हणीय mfn. (-यः-या-यं) Censurable, contemptible, vile, bad.  E. गर्ह् to abuse, अनीयर् aff.
गर्हा: गर्हा f. (-र्हा) Abuse, censure, reproach.  E. गर्ह् to revile, affixes अङ् and टाप्.
गर्हित: गर्हित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 	 1. Blamed, censured. 	 2. Contemned, despised. 3. Bad, vile.  E. गर्ह् to blame, क्त aff.
गर्ह्य: गर्ह्य mfn. (-र्ह्यः-र्ह्या-र्ह्यं) Low, vile, contemptible.  E. गर्ह् to abuse, affix यत्.
गर्ह्यवादिन्: गर्ह्यवादिन् mfn. (-दी-दिनी-दि) Speaking ill, speaking vilely or inaccurate-ly.  E. गर्ह्य vile, and वादिन् who speaks.
गल: गल r. 1st cl. (गलति) 	 1. To eat. 	 2. To ooze; also (ङ्) गलङ् r. 10th cl. (गलयते) To drop, to ooze or distil. With अव prefixed, To fall, to fall down or off; With वि, 1. To go, to approach. 	 2. To bear or support.

गल m. (-लः) 	 1. The throat. 	 2. The resin of the Sal tree. 	 3. A reed, a large kind of the Saccharum cylindricum. 	 4. A rope. 	 5. A musical instrument. 	 6. A kind of fish, a small kind of cyprinus, a subgenus of that class, (Cyprinus garra. HAM.)  E. गल् to eat, to drop, &c. affix अच्, or गॄ to swallow, with अच्, गर, and र changed to ल.
गलक: गलक m. (-कः) A kind of fish.  E. कन् added to the preceding.
गलकम्बल: गलकम्बल m. (-लः) A bull's dewlap.  E. गल the neck, and कम्बल a soft substance as a blanket, &c.
गलगण्ड: गलगण्ड m. (-ण्डः) Inflammation, enlargement of the glands of the neck. E. गल throat and गण्ड a swelling or boil.
गलग्रह: गलग्रह m. (-हः) 	 1. A sauce of fish ground up with salt, pepper, Ghee, &c. 	 2. A day on which a course of study is commenced, but imme-diately preceding a day on which study is prohibited. 	 3. The fourth lunation of the dark fortnight, the seventh eighth, and ninth, the thirteenth and three days following. 	 4. Seizing any one by the throat, throttling, choking.  E. गल the throat, and ग्रह what takes, &c.; also गलग्रहण.
गलत्: गलत् mfn. (-लन्-लन्ती-लत्) 	 1. Falling, dropping. 	 2. Oozing, trickling, flowing. 	 3. Melting.  E. गल् to flow, शतृ aff.
गलन: गलन n. (-नं) 	 1. Melting, fusing. 	 2. Trickling, dropping, oozing. 	 3. Fall-ing. down or off. 	 4. Leaking.  E. गल् to drop, ल्युट् aff.
गलनीय: गलनीय mfn. (-यः-या-यं) Fusible, liquefiable, to be melted, &c.  E. गल् to melt, अनीयर् affix; also गलितव्य and गल्य.
गलन्तिका: गलन्तिका f. (-का) 	 1. A small pitcher. 	 2. A small water jar with small holes in the bottom, from which the water drops upon a Linga or Tulasi plant, placed beneath.  E. गड् to drop, affix झच्, गडन्ति कन् in the fem. form added, and ड changed to ल.
गलमेखला: गलमेखला f. (-ला) A thread worn round the neck, a necklace.  E. गल the throat, and मेखला a girdle.
गलव्रत: गलव्रत m. (-तः) A peacock.  E. गल the throat, व्रत holy observance. also the same as गरव्रत q. v. ल being substituted for र.
गलशुण्डिका: गलशुण्डिका f. (-का) The uvula or soft palate.  E. गल the throat, and शुण्डिका the elephant's trunk, resembling it in being a pendulous, roundish, and fleshy substance.
गलस्तनी: गलस्तनी f. (-नी) A she-goat.  E. गल the throat, and स्तन the breast; some species of the Bengal goat have small fleshy processes, resembling nipples depending from the throat; also गलस्तनी.
गलहस्त: गलहस्त m. (-स्तः) Throttling.  E. गल, and हस्त the hand.
गलाङ्कुर: गलाङ्कुर m. (-रः) A disease of the throat, inflammation of the fauces, and enlargement of the tonsils.  E. गल the throat, and अङ्कुर a new sprout.
गलाविल: गलाविल m. (-लः) A prawn or shrimp: see गङ्गाटेय. Some books read this गलानिल, and others गलानिक.
गलि: गलि m. (-लिः) A strong and lazy ox.  E. गल् to eat, and इन् affix; who is good for nothing but eating.
गलित: गलित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 	 1. Fallen, dropped. 	 2. Liquefied, melted. 	 3. Dis-tilled, oozing, flowing. 	 4. Decayed, impaired. 	 5. Lost, deprived. 6. Untied, loosed.  E. गल् to drop, to ooze, affix क्त.
गलितकुष्ठ: गलितकुष्ठ n. (-ष्ठं) Advanced and incurable leprosy, when the fingers and toes fall off.  E. गलित, and कुष्ठ leprosy.
गलितदन्त: गलितदन्त mfn. (-न्तः-न्ता-न्तं) Toothless.  E. गलित, and दन्त tooth.
गलितनख: गलितनख mfn. (-खः-खा-खी-खं) Having no nails.  E. गलित, and नख the nail.
गलितनयन: गलितनयन mfn. (-नः-ना-नं) Blind.  E. गलित, and नयन the eye.
गलेगण्ड: गलेगण्ड m. (-ण्डः) A kind of bird, (the Adjutant or Ardea argala.)  E. गल the throat, in the seventh case, and गण्ड a boil; alluding to a pen-dulous fleshy purse hanging from the throat.
गलेस्तनी: गलेस्तनी f. (-नी) A she-goat; see गलस्तनी.
गलू: गलू m. (-लूः) A sort of gem.
गल्भ: गल्भ r. 1st cl. (गल्भते) To be bold or confident.
गल्भ mfn. (-ल्भः-ल्भा-ल्भं) 	 1. Proud, haughty. 	 2. Confident, bold, auda-cious.  E. गल्भ् to be proud, &c. अच् affix, more commonly प्रगलभ.
गल्या: गल्या f. (-ल्या) 	 1. A multitude of throats. 	 2. A quantity of a kind of grass, or ropes made of it.  E. गल a throat, &c. य aff.
गल्ल: गल्ल m. (-ल्लः) The cheek.  E. गल् to eat, and ल affix; from ला to get or receive.
गल्लचातुरी: गल्लचातुरी f. (-री) A small round pillow to put underneath the cheek. E. गल्ल the cheek, and चातुर a pillow.
गल्वर्क: गल्वर्क m. (-र्कः) 	 1. A goblet, a vessel for drinking spirituous liquor. 	 2. Lapis lazuli.  E. गल् to drop, deriv. irr.
गल्ह: गल्ह r. 1st cl. (गल्हते) To blame, to censure or despise: see गर्ह.
गवय: गवय m. (-यः) 	 1. A species of ox, the Gayal, erroneously classed by Hindu writers amongst the kinds of deer, (Bos gavæus.) 	 2. A monkey chief: the son of VAIVASWATA. 	 f. (-यी) The female Gayal. E. गु to sound, and अय affix, form irregular; or गो a cow, and य from या to obtain. affix ड, resembling a cow.
गवराज: गवराज m. (-जः) A bull.  E. गो a cow, affix अण् गव relating to a cow, and राजन् king, chief; the more direct compound makes गोराज.
गवल: गवल m. (-लः) A wild buffalo. 	 n. (-लं) Buffalo's horn.  E. गु to sound, अलच् aff.
गवाक्ष: गवाक्ष m. (-क्षः) 	 1. An air hole, a loop hole, a round window, a bull's eye, &c. 	 2. A monkey chief; one of the sons of VAIVASWATA. E. गो a ray of light, अक्ष् to spread, affix घञ्, or गो an ox, and अक्ष an eye; ox eyed. 	 f. (क्षी) A sort of cucumber, (Cucumis madraspata-nus.) 	 2. A plant, (Clitoria ternatea:) see अपराजिता.  E. गो the earth, अक्ष् to spread, affix अण् or ङीप्.
गवाक्षजाल: गवाक्षजाल n. (-लं) A lattice, a jalousie, trellice work.  E. गवाक्ष, and जाल a net.
गवादन: गवादन n. (-नं) Pasture or meadow grass. 	 f. (-नी) 	 1. A hay rack, a trough for holding grass out of which cattle feed. 	 2. A species of cucum-ber, (Cucumis madraspatanus, or, according to some, C. coloquin-tida.) 	 3. A plant, (Clitoria ternatea:) see the preceding.  E. गो a cow, अदन food, fem. affix ङीप्.
गवालूक: गवालूक m. (-कः) The Gayal, (Bos gavæus:) see गवय.  E. गो a cow, लोक to see, with आङ् prefixed, deriv. irr.; in appearance a cow.
गवाशन: गवाशन m. (-नः) An outcaste.  E. गव, and अशन who eats, eating beef.
गवाह्निक: गवाह्निक n. (-कं) A day's feed for a cow.  E. गो and आह्निक daily.
गवीश्वर: गवीश्वर mfn. (-रः-रा-रं) Owner of kine.  E. गो a cow, ईश्वर a lord or master.
गवेडु: गवेडु m. (-डुः) A cloud. 	 f. (-डुः) A kind of grain, (Coix barbata.)  E. गो a cow or the earth, एड् to preserve, उ affix, or with कन् added गवेडुका also गवेधु, &c.
गवेधु: गवेधु f. (-धुः) Coix barbata: see the preceding; also with कन् added गवेधुका.
गवेरुक: गवेरुक n. (-कं) Red chalk.  E. गो light or colour, ईर् to send, affix वुन्, and the penultimate changed to उ irregularly; also read गवेधुक.
गवेष: गवेष r. 10th cl. (गवेषयति) 	 1. To seek, to hunt for, to search or inquire. 2. To make an effort.
गवेषण: गवेषण nf. (-णं-णा) Research, inquiry after any thing, (physical or phi-losophical, &c.)  E. गवेष to inquire, affix युच्.
गवेषित: गवेषित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Sought, inquired for.  E. गवेष to search or hunt, affix क्त.
गवोद्व: गवोद्व m. (-द्वः) An excellent cow.  E. गो a cow, and उद्व implying excel-lence; the compound remains masculine.
गव्य: गव्य mfn. (-व्यः-व्या-व्यं) 	 1. Of or belonging to a cow, (as milk, curds, &c.) 2. Proper or fit for cattle. 	 nf. (-व्यं-व्या) A bowstring. 	 f. (-व्या) 	 1. A multitude of cows. 	 2. A measure of two Kos: see गव्यूति. 	 n. (-व्यं) A colouring substance, a yellow pigment or dye.  E. गो a cow, &c. and यत् aff.
गव्यूत: गव्यूत n. (-तं) 	 1. A Kos, a measure of length equal 4000 cubits. 	 2. A measure of two Kos: see the next.
गव्यूति: गव्यूति mf. (-तिः) A measure of two Kos, a league measured by 2000 Dands or fathoms.  E. गो the earth, यु to join, क्तिन् affix, deriv. irr.
गह: गह r. 10th cl. (-गहयति) To be thick or impervious as a forest, &c.
गह m. (-ह) A cave. 	 2. A forest.  E. गह् to be impervious अच् aff.
गहन: गहन mfn. (-नः-ना-नं) Impervious, inaccessible. 	 n. (-नं) 	 1. A wood, a thicket. 	 2. A cave. 	 3. Pain, distress.  E. गाह् to tremble, &c. affix युच्, and the radical vowel made short; or गह् to be thick, affix as before.
गहीय: गहीय mfn. (-यः-या-यं) Relating to a cave or a thicket, which is deep and difficult of access, impervious.  E. गह a thicket, छ aff.
गह्वर: गह्वर nf. (-रं-री) A cave, a cavern, a grotto, a recess in a rock or moun-tain, &c. 	 n. (-रं) 	 1. A thicket, a wood. 	 2. Hypocrisy. 	 3. Weeping, crying, but not violently. 	 m. (-रः) An arbour, a bower.  E. गाह to be agitated, and ष्वरच् Unadi affix, the radical vowel made short.
गा: गा r. 1st cl. (ङ) गाङ् (गाते) To go, to go to or towards. r. 3rd. cl. but restricted to the Vedas. (जगाति) To praise.
गा f. (-गा) A verse or metrical composition.  E. गै to sing, क and टाप् affixes: see ग.
गाङ्ग: गाङ्ग mfn. (-ङ्गः-ङ्गी-ङ्गं) Belonging or relating to the river Ganges. 	 m. (-ङ्गः) 	 1. A name of KARTIKEYA. 	 2. A name of BHISHMA  E. गङ्गा the GANGA, अण् aff.
गाङ्गट: गाङ्गट m. (-टः) A prawn or shrimp.  E. गाङ्ग relating to the Ganges, and अट what goes, form irr.; also गाङ्गाट or with कन् affix गाङ्गाटक.
गाङ्गटय: गाङ्गटय m. (-यः) A shrimp or prawn.  E. गङ्गा, अट् to go, and ढक् affix also गङ्गाटेय, and गाङ्गाट, &c.
गाङ्गायनि: गाङ्गायनि f. (-निः) 	 1. A name of BHISHMA. 	 2. A name of KARTIKEYA, E. गङ्गा the personified river, (as the wife of SANTANU, in the first instance, and mother of the hero; and in the second, as the receiver of KARTIKEYA, the son of SIVA, from AGNI, the god of fire.) and फिञ् patronymic aff.
गाङ्गेय: गाङ्गेय m. (-यः) 	 1. BHISHMA. 	 2. KARTIKEYA: see the preceding. 	 3. The Hilsa or Illias fish, (Cluponodon ilisha, HAM.) 	 n. (-यं) 	 1. Gold. 	 2. A grass: see कशेरु. 	 3. A fragrant grass, (Cyperus rotundus.) E. गङ्गा the Ganges, ढक् affix of descent, &c.
गाङ्गेरुकी: गाङ्गेरुकी f. (-की) A plant, (Hedysarum lagopodioides, but it is vari-ously described.)  E. गाङ्ग Ganges water, ईर् to go or grow, उकन् aff.
गाङ्गौघ: गाङ्गौघ n. (-घं) The current of the Ganges.  E. गाङ्ग Gangetic, and ओघ heap.
गाढ: गाढ adv. 	 n. (-ढं) adj. 	 mfn. (ढः-ढा-ढं) 	 1. Excessive, much, very much, heavy, oppressive, &c. 	 2. Firm, strong. 	 3. Hard. 	 4. Close.  E. गाह् to agitate, affix क्त, deriv. irr.
गाढता: गाढता f. (-ता) 	 1. Firmness, hardness. 	 2. Excess.  E. गाढ, and तल affix; also with त्व, गाढत्वं.
गाढमुष्टि: गाढमुष्टि mfn. (-ष्टिः-ष्टिः-ष्टि) Miserly, niggard, avaricious, close-fisted m. (-ष्टिः) A scymitar, a large sacrificial knife.  E. गाढ heavy or close, and मुष्टि gripe.
गाणपत: गाणपत mfn. (-तः-ती-तं) Relating to GANESHA, or the leader of a troop, &c.  E. गणपति, and अण् aff.
गाणपत्य: गाणपत्य mfn. (-त्यः-त्यी-त्यं) Relating to GANAPATI or GANESHA. 	 m. (-त्यः) A worshipper of him. 	 n. (-त्यं) 	 1. Worship of him. 	 2. Chieftainship, presidency.  E. गणपति, and ष्यण् aff.
गाणिक्य: गाणिक्य n. (-क्यं) An assembly of harlots.  E. गणिका a whore, यञ् aff.
गाण्डिव: गाण्डिव mn. (-वः-वं) 	 1. The bow of ARJUNA. 	 2. Any bow; also गाण्डीव.
गाण्डीव: गाण्डीव mn. (-वः-वं) 	 1. The bow of ARJUNA. 	 2. Any bow.  E. गाण्डी what affects the cheek, from गण्ड with इञ् affix, then व added, and इ final lengthened; or continuing short, गाण्डिव.
गाण्डीविन्: गाण्डीविन् m. (-वी) A name of ARJUNA.  E. गाण्डीव ARJUNA'S bow, and इनि aff.
गातु: गातु mfn. (-तुः-तुः-तु) Angry, wrathful. 	 m. (-तुः) 	 1. A Gandharba or celestial quirister. 	 2. The Kokila or Indian cuckoo. 	 3. A large black bee. 	 4. A singer.  E. गै to sing, Unadi affix तु.
गातृ: गातृ mf. (-ता-त्री) A male or female singer.  E. गै to sing, तृच् aff.
गात्र: गात्र n. (-त्रं) 	 1. The body. 	 2. The fore quarter of an elephant. 	 3. A limb, a member.  E. गम् to go, ष्ट्रन् Unadi affix, the radical final is reject-ed, and the vowel made long.
गात्रभङ्गा: गात्रभङ्गा f. (-ङ्गा) Cowach, (Carpopogon pruriens.)  E. गात्र the body, and भङ्गा what breaks or hurts.
गात्रमार्जनी: गात्रमार्जनी f. (-नी) A towel.  E. गात्र, and मार्जनी a wiper.
गात्रसङ्कोचिन्: गात्रसङ्कोचिन् m. (-ची) The pole-cat, (Viverra putorius)  E. गात्र the body, and सङ्कोचिन् who draws up or contracts in order to spring upon prey.
गात्रसम्प्लव: गात्रसम्प्लव m. (-वः) A small bird, the diver.  E. गात्र the body, and सम्प्लव who plunges, from सम् entirely, प्लुङ to go, and अच् aff.
गात्रानुलेपनी: गात्रानुलेपनी f. (-नी) Fragrant unguents, &c. smeared upon the body, perfume for the person.  E. गात्र the body, अनु upon लिप् to plaster or smear, and ल्युट् aff.
गात्रोत्सादन: गात्रोत्सादन n. (-नं) Cleaning the person with perfumes, &c.  E. गात्र and उत्सादन cleaning.
गाथक: गाथक m. (-कः) 	 1. A musician, a singer. 	 2. A chaunter of the Puranas or sacred poems.  E. गै to sing. स्थकन् aff.
गाथा: गाथा f. (-थां) 	 1. A verse, a stanza. 	 2. Metre, rhythm. 	 3. A song, a chant or verse to be chanted or sung. 	 4. Prakrita or any language not Sanskrit. 	 5. The same as the Aryya Metre, in which the verse con-tains sixty syllabic instants, variously arranged.  E. गै to sing, थन् Unadi aff.
गाथाकार: गाथाकार m. (-रः) A singer. A reciter.  E. गाथा, कृ to make, अण् aff.
गाथिक: गाथिक m. (-कः) One who recites Gathas, verses or hymns.  E. गाथा, and ठक् aff.
गाध: गाध (ऋ) गाधृ r. 1st. cl. (गाधते) 	 1. To stand, to stay, to remain. 	 2. To seek, to search or enquire for. 	 3. To compile. string or heap together.
गाध mfn. (-धः-धा-धं) Not very deep. 	 m. (-धः) 	 1. Place, site. 	 2. Desire of gain, cupidity, covetousness. 	 3. Bottom, soundings.  E. गाध् to stand, &c. affix अच्.
गाधि: गाधि m. (-धिः) The name of a king sovereign of Kanyakubja, father of ViSWAMITRA.
गाधिज: गाधिज m. (-जः) 	 1. A name of the celebrated saint VISWAMITRA.  E. गाधि as above, and ज born.
गाधिपुर: गाधिपुर n. (-रं) Kanyakubja the ancient Kanouj.  E. गाधि a proper name an पुर a city; the capital of GADHI.
गाधिभू: गाधिभू m. (-भूः) The saint VISWAMITRA.  E. गाधि, and भू born, the son of GADHI.
गाधेय: गाधेय m. (-यः) VISWAMITRA.  E. गाधि and ढक् patronymic affix: see the preceding.
गान: गान n. (-नं) 	 1. Singing, song in general, or a song. 	 2. Sound.  E. गै to sing affix ल्युट्;
गानिनी: गानिनी f. (-नी) Orris root.  E. गान song, इनि and ङीप् affixes; supposed to be of use in clearing the voice.
गानीय: गानीय mfn. (-यः-या-यं) Musical.  E. गान and छ aff.
गान्तु: गान्तु mfn. (-न्तुः-न्तुः-न्तु) A goer, a traveller, one who goes or moves E. गम् to go, Unadi affix तु, and the radical vowel made long.
गान्त्री: गान्त्री f. (-न्त्री) A carriage drawn by oxen.  E. गम् to go, ष्ट्रन्. affix, fem. do. ङीष् and the pen. made long; also गन्त्रा.
गान्दिनी: गान्दिनी f. (-नी) 	 1. The river Ganges, or the goddess Ganga. 	 2. The mother of AkRURA.  E. गो paradise, in the accusative case, द who gives, इनि and ङीप् affs.
गान्दिनीसुत: गान्दिनीसुत m. (-तः) 	 1. A name of BHISHMA, &c. 	 2. AkRURA.  E. गान्दिनी GANGA, and सुत a son: see गङ्गासुत.
गान्धर्ब्ब: गान्धर्ब्ब mfn. (-र्ब्बः-र्ब्बी-र्ब्बं) Relating or belonging to a Gandharba. 	 m. (-र्ब्बः) A heavenly quirister: see गन्धर्ब्बं n. र्ब्बं 1. Song; singing. 	 2. A form of marriage, that which require only mutual and amorous agreement.  E. गन्धर्ब्ब a Gandharba, and अण् aff.
गान्धार: गान्धार m. (-रः) 	 1. One of the seven primary notes of music. 	 2. Minium or red lead. 	 3. A country, (Candahar, between the north of India and Persia). 	 n. (-रं) Gum myrrh f. (-री) 	 1. The wife of DHRITARASH-TRA mother of DURYODHANA. 	 2. One of the tutelary female deities of the Jainas. 	 3. A plant (Hedysarum alhagi.) 	 4. Prickly nightshade. E. गान्ध the aggregate of गन्ध smell, &c. ऋ to go and अण् affix; the note being said to be produced by pure and fragrant breath, &c. गान्धारेय m. (-यः) A name of DURYODHANA, the son of DHRI-TARASHTRA.  E. गान्धारी the name of the mother of this chief, and ढक् aff.
गान्धिक: गान्धिक m. (-कः) 	 1. A scribe, a clerk. 	 2. A vender of perfumes, a per-fumer. 	 3. A kind of worm, having a strong fetid smell.  E. गन्ध smell, and ठञ् aff.
गामुक: गामुक mfn. (-कः-का or -की-कं) Going, locomotive.  E. गम् to go, उकञ् aff.
गाम्भीर्य: गाम्भीर्य्य n. (-र्य्यं) 	 1. Depth, (of water, sound, &c.) 	 2. The deep sound of the voice of a jaina saint, like distant thunder or the muttering of clouds.  E. गम्भीर deep, affix ष्यञ् or ज्य.
गाम्भीर्य्य: गाम्भीर्य्य n. (-र्य्यं) 	 1. Depth, (of water, sound, &c.) 	 2. The deep sound of the voice of a jaina saint, like distant thunder or the muttering of clouds.  E. गम्भीर deep, affix ष्यञ् or ज्य.
गायक: गायक mfn. (-कः-की-कं) Singing, one who sings. 	 m. (-कः) A singer.  E. गै to sing, ण्वुल् aff.
गायत्: गायत् mfn. (-यन्-यन्ती-यत्) Singing.  E. गै to sing. affix शतृ.
गायत्रिन्: गायत्रिन् m. (-त्री) A tree that yields the resin formerly called Terra Japonica, (Mimosa catechu;) also गायत्री fem. noun, as below.
गायत्री: गायत्री f. (-त्री) 	 1. A measure of verse in the Vedas, a stanza usually of twenty-four syllables, variously arranged, but most commonly in three lines. 	 2. A sacred verse from the Vedas to be recited only men-tally; this is usually personified and considered as a goddess, the wife of BRAHMA; the metaphorical mother of the three first clas-ses, in their capacity of twice born, investiture with the sacred and distinguishing string, &c. being regarded as a new birth; there is but one Gayatri of the Vedas, but according to the system of the Tantrikas, a number of mystical verses are called Gayatris; each deity has one in particular. 	 3. A kind of mimosa, (M. catechu:) see the preceding, &c.  E. गायन् who sings, and त्रै to preserve, affix-es क and ङीष्; this applies especially to the mystical verse, the repetition of which is necessary for salvation; the word is also writ-ten गायत्त्री.
गायन: गायन mfn. (-नः-नी-नं) Singing, a singer. 	 m. (-नः) 	 1. A singer. 	 2. A chatterer, a gossip. 	 n. (-नं) 	 1. Singing 2. Professing or practising singing as a livelihood.  E. गै to sing. aff. ल्युट्.
गारित्र: गारित्र m. (-त्रः) Rice, grain, corn.  E. ग to swallow, Unadi affix णित्रन्.
गारुड: गारुड m. (-डः) 	 1. Gold. 	 2. A Mantra or charm against poison. 	 3. An emerald.  E. गरुड the vehicle of VISHNU, and अण् affix; of or rela-ting to GARUDA.
गारुडिक: गारुडिक m. (-कः) A charmer, a dealer in antidotes.  E. गारुड the mantra of GARUDA, or a charm against venom, and ठक् aff.
गारुत्मत्: गारुत्मत् n. (-त्) The emerald.  E. गरुत्मत् GARUDA, and अण् affix; derived from or relating to GARUDA; the gem is supposed to be generated from his voided phlegm.
गार्ग: गार्ग्ग mfn. (-र्ग्गः-र्ग्गी-र्ग्गं) Descended from the sage GARGA.  E. गर्ग्ग, and अण् aff.
गार्ग्ग: गार्ग्ग mfn. (-र्ग्गः-र्ग्गी-र्ग्गं) Descended from the sage GARGA.  E. गर्ग्ग, and अण् aff.
गार्गक: गार्ग्गक n. (-कं) A multitude of the descendents of the saint GARGA. E. गार्ग्ग a descendant of GARGA, and वुञ् affix of multitude; also with ठञ्, गार्ग्गिक.
गार्ग्गक: गार्ग्गक n. (-कं) A multitude of the descendents of the saint GARGA. E. गार्ग्ग a descendant of GARGA, and वुञ् affix of multitude; also with ठञ्, गार्ग्गिक.
गार्गीपुत्रकायनि: गार्ग्गीपुत्रकायनि m. (-निः) A descendant of the son of GARGI.  E. गार्ग्गी the wife of the saint GARGA, पुत्र a son, and फिञ् affix, कुक् augment; also without the augment गार्ग्गीपुत्रायनि, or with इञ् affix, गार्ग्गीपुत्रि.
गार्ग्गीपुत्रकायनि: गार्ग्गीपुत्रकायनि m. (-निः) A descendant of the son of GARGI.  E. गार्ग्गी the wife of the saint GARGA, पुत्र a son, and फिञ् affix, कुक् augment; also without the augment गार्ग्गीपुत्रायनि, or with इञ् affix, गार्ग्गीपुत्रि.
गार्ग्ग्य: गार्ग्ग्य mfn. (-र्ग्ग्यः-र्ग्ग्यी-र्ग्ग्यं) Descended from the GARGA, son, daughter, &c.  E. गर्ग्ग and ष्यञ् aff.
गार्द्ध: गार्द्ध mfn. (-र्द्धः-र्द्धी-र्द्धं) 	 1. Derived from a vulture. 	 2. Greedy. 	 m. (-र्द्धः) 	 1. Desire, greediness, cupidity. 	 2. An arrow.  E. गृध greedy, affix अण् or गृध्र with अण् affix, and र rejected optionally.
गार्धपक्ष: गार्द्धपक्षं m. (-क्षः) An arrow.  E. गार्द्ध and पक्ष a wing; formed with vulture's feathers.
गार्द्धपक्षं: गार्द्धपक्षं m. (-क्षः) An arrow.  E. गार्द्ध and पक्ष a wing; formed with vulture's feathers.
गार्द्धपत्र: गार्द्धपत्र m. (-त्रः) An arrow. E. As before, पत्र a leaf, a wing.
गार्द्ध्य: गार्द्ध्य n. (-र्द्ध्यं) 	 1. Greediness. 	 2. Desire.  E. गृध्र greedy, यञ् aff.
गार्द्ध्र: गार्द्ध्र mfn. (-र्द्ध्रः-र्द्ध्री-र्द्ध्रं) Derived from a vulture,  E. गृद्ध्र and अण् aff.
गार्द्ध्रपक्ष: गार्द्ध्रपक्ष m. (-क्षः) An arrow.  E. गार्द्ध्र, and पक्ष a wing.
गार्भ: गार्भ mfn. (-र्भः-र्भी-र्भं) 	 1. Uterine, fœtal. 	 2. Relating to conception, (any act or ceremony, &c.)  E. गर्भ and अण् aff.
गार्भिक: गार्भिक mfn. (-कः-की-कं) 	 1. Fœtal, uterine. 	 2. Relating to or connected with gestation or the fœtus in utero.  E. गर्भ and ठञ् aff.
गार्भिण: गार्भिण n. (-णं) A number of pregnant woman.  E. गर्भिणी a pregnant we-man, and अण् aff.
गार्भिण्य: गार्भिण्य n. (-ण्यं) An assembly of pregnant women.  E. गर्भिणी as above, and यञ् aff.
गार्हपत्य: गार्हपत्य m. (-त्यः) A sacred fire perpetually maintained by a household-er, received from his father, and transmitted to his descendants, and from which fires for sacrificial purposes are lighted.  E. गृहपति a householder, (from गृह a house, and पति master,) and य्य referen-tial aff.
गार्हस्थ्य: गार्हस्थ्य n. (-स्थ्यं) The order or estate of a householder.  E. गृहस्थ and यञ् aff.
गाल: गाल m. (-लः) 	 1. Flowing, liquefying. 	 2. Flowing, dropping. 	 3. A flux. E. गल् to flow, घञ् aff.
गालन: गालन n. (-नं) 	 1. Straining fluids. 	 2. Fusing, liquefying, &c.  E. गल् to flow, causal form, affix ल्युट्.
गालव: गालव m. (-वः) 	 1. A tree, the bark of which is used in dying, Lodh, (Symplocus racemosa, Rox.) 	 2. A pale species of the same: see लोध्र. 	 3. A kind of ebony; also केन्दुक, (Diospyros glutinosa.) 	 4. A particular Muni or saint, a disciple of VISWAMITRA.  E. गाल flux, and व what prevents; referring to the astringent qualities of the Lodh.
गालि: गालि m. (-लिः) A curse, execration or imprecation.  E. गल् in the causal from to cause to drop, and इन् aff.
गालित: गालित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 	 1. Melted, fused. 	 2. Strained. 	 3. Distilled, drop-ped.  E. गल् to drop, causal form, क्त aff.
गालिन्: गालिन् mfn. (-ली-लिनी-लि) 	 1. Fusing, liquefying. 	 2. Distilling. 	 3. Abusive, abusing. 	 f. (-नी) A particular gesticulation or Mudra.  E. गल to flow, causal form, णिनि aff.
गालोड्य: गालोड्य n. (-ड्यं) The seed of the lotus.
गाह: गाह(ऊ)गाहू r. 1st cl. (गाहते) 	 1. To churn, to stir or agitate. 	 2. To penetrate. 	 3. To destroy. With अव or वि prefixed, To bathe, to perform ablutions. With वि, to shake, to agitate.
गाहित: गाहित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 	 1. Shaking, trembling. 	 2. Destroyed. 	 3. Plunged into, immersed.  E. गाह् to agitate, क्त aff.
गाहितृ: गाहितृ mfn. (-ता-त्री-तृ) 	 1. Shaking, agitating. 	 2. Destroying, a destroyer. 3. One who plunges into water, bathes, dives, &c.  E. गाह् to agitate, तृच् aff.
गिर्: गिर् f. (-गोः) 	 1. Speech, speaking. 	 2. A name of SARASWATI the goddess of speech. 	 3. Fame, celebrity.  E. गॄ to sound, affix क्विप्, ऋ is changed to इर्.
गिरण: गिरण n. (-णं) Swallowing.  E. गॄ to swallow, ल्युट् aff.
गिरा: गिरा f. (-रा) Speech. गॄ to sound, क and टाप् affs.
गिर: गिर mfn. (-रिः-रिः-रि) Venerable, respectable worshipful. 	 m. (-रिः) 	 1. A mountain, a hill. 	 2. A wooden ball with which children play. 	 3. A. disease of the eyes. 	 f. (-रिः) 	 1. Swallowing. 	 2. A small rat, a mouse. 3. A title given to one order of the Dasnami Gosains.  E. गॄ to swallow, &c. इ Unadi aff.
गिरिकण्टक: गिरिकण्टक m. (-कः) INDRA'S thunderbolt.  E. गिरि a mountain, and कण्टक a thorn, tearing or splitting rocks.
गिरिकदम्ब: गिरिकदम्ब m. (-म्बः) A species of Kadamba, (Nauclea cadamba.)  E. गिरि, and कदम्ब the same.
गिरिकन्दर: गिरिकन्दर m. (-रः) A cave, a cavern.  E. गिरि, and कन्दर a cave.
गिरिकदली: गिरिकदली f. (-ली) A species of plantain growing in hilly countries. E. गिरि, and कदली a plantain.
गिरिकर्णिका: गिरिकर्णिका f. (-का) The earth.  E. गिरि a mountain, and कर्ण an ear, affixes कन् and टाप्; the mountain-eared.
गिरिकर्णी: गिरिकर्णी f. (-र्णी) 	 1. A plant, commonly Jawasa, (Hedysarum alhaji.) 2. A different plant, (Clitoria ternatea:) see अपराजिता.  E. गिरि a mouse, and कर्णी an ear, affix ङीष्, the mouse-ear-leaved.
गिरिका: गिरिका f. (-का) A small rat, a mouse.  E. कन् added to गिरि the same.
गिरिकाण: गिरिकाण m. (-णः) A blind or one-eyed man, one blind from a particular disease.  E. गिरि as above, and काण one-eyed.
गिरिगुड: गिरिगुड m. (-डः) A ball for playing with.  E. गिरि, and गुड, each mean-ing the same thing, a ball.
गिरिज: गिरिज mfn. (-जः-जा-जं) Mountain-born, mountaineer. &c. 	 m. (-जः) The Mahuwa tree, (Bassia.) 	 f. (-जा) 	 1. A name of goddes PARVATI, as the daughter of the personified HIMALAYA mountain 2. The Shad-dock or pumplemouce, (Citrus decumana.) 	 3. A plant considered as a white species of Rasna: see राम्ना. 	 4. The hill plantain. 	 5. Jas-mine. 	 6. A pebble, a small stone. 	 n. (-जं) 	 1. Talc. 	 2. Benzoin or gum benjamin; it is also confounded with styrax, another gum resin. 	 3. Bitumen. 	 4. Iron.  E. गिरि, and ज born.
गिरिजामल: गिरिजामल n. (-लं) Talc.  E. गिरिज mountain-born, and अमल clear, clean; also गिरिज, and अमल severally.
गिरिज्वर: गिरिज्वर m. (-रः) The thunderbolt.  E. गिरि a mountain, and ज्वर what burns.
गिरित: गिरित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 	 1. Eaten. 	 2. Swallowed.  E. गॄ to swallow, affix क्त; also गिलित.
गिरिदुर्ग: गिरिदुर्ग n. (-र्गं) A hill fort or any stronghold amongst mountains. E. गिरि, and दुर्ग a place of difficult access.
गिरिधातु: गिरिधातु m. (-तुः) Red chalk.  E. गिरि, and धातु a mineral.
गिरिध्वज: गिरिध्वज m. (-जः) A thunderbolt.  E. गिरि, and ध्वज a banner.
गिरिपुष्पक: गिरिपुष्पक n. (-कं) Bitumen,  E. गिरि, and पुष्प a flower; कन् affix of simili-tude.
गिरिपृष्ठ: गिरिपृष्ठ n. (-ष्ठं) The top of a hill.  E. गिरि, and पृष्ठ back.
गिरिप्रिय: गिरिप्रिय mfn. (-यः-या-यं) Fond of or frequenting mountains. 	 f. (-या) The Yak.  E. गिरि, and प्रिय fond of.
गिरिभिद्: गिरिभिद् m. (-भित्) A plant, (Plectranthus scutellaroides.)  E. गिरि, and भिद् what breaks.
गिरिभू: गिरिभू mfn. (-भूः-भूः-भु) Mountaineer, mountain-born. 	 f. (-भूः) PARVATI. 	 m. (-भूः) A small stone.  E. गिरि, and भू born.
गिरिमल्लिका: गिरिमल्लिका f. (-का) A plant, (Echites antidysenterica:) see कुटज.  E. गिरि a mountain, and मल्ली a jasmin, कन् affix of similitude.
गिरिमान: गिरिमान m. (-नः) A large and powerful elephant.  E. गिरि a mountain, and मान measure, like a mountain in bulk.
गिरिमृत्: गिरिमृत् f. (-मृत्) 	 1. Red chalk. 	 2. Mountain-soil.  E. गिरि a mountain, and मृत् clay, earth.
गिरिमृद्भव: गिरिमृद्भव n. (-वं) Red chalk. गिरिमृत्, and भव produced.
गिरिमेद: गिरिमेद m. (-दः) A foetid mimosa.  E. गिरि, and मेद filth.
गिरियक: गिरियक m. (-कः) A ball for playing with.  E. गिरि a ball, घ pleonastic affix, and कन् added; also गिरियाक the pen. being lengthened.
गिरियाक: गिरियाक m. (-कः) A ball; see the preceding.
गिरिवासिन्: गिरिवासिन् mfn. (-सी-सिनी-सि) Living in the mountains, being or pro-duced in them. 	 m. (-सी) A large kind of Arum.  E. गिरि, and वासिन् what abides.
गिरिश: गिरिश m. (-शः) A name of SIVA.  E. गिरि a mountain, and शीञ् to sleep, affix ड; inhabiting mount Kailasa, or frequenting the Himalaya range.
गिरिशालिनी: गिरिशालिनी f. (-नी) A plant, (Clitoria ternatea.)  E. गिरि, and शालिनी what grows in.
गिरिशृङ्ग: गिरिशृङ्ग m. (-ङ्गः) 	 1. A name of GANESA. 	 2. A peak of a mountain. E. गिरि a mount, and शृङ्ग a peak, alluding to his bulk, or गिरि the mountain Kailasa, and शृङ्ग a peak.
गिरिसार: गिरिसार m. (-रः) 	 1. The Malaya mountains, situated in the south of India. 	 2. Iron. 	 3. Tin.  E. गिरि a mountain, and सार essence.
गिरिसुता: गिरिसुता f. (-ता) PARVATI.  E. गिरि Himalaya, and सुता daughter.
गिरीश: गिरीश m. (-शः) 	 1. A name of SIVA. 	 2. A name of Himalaya, the snowy mountains on the north of Hindustan, or the range personified 3. A name of VRIHASPATI.  E. गिरि a mountain, (or in the last mean-ing, गिर् speech,) and ईश lord.
गिल: गिल mfn. (-लः-ला-लं) Who or what swallows. 	 m. (-लः) 	 1. The citron. 2. Swallowing.  E. गॄ to swallow, affix क, and र changed to ल.
गिलग्राह: गिलग्राह m. (-हः) A shark.  E. गिल, and ग्राह who seizes, who swallows.
गिलत्: गिलत् mfn. (-लन्-लन्ती-लत्) Swallowing, eating, devouring.  E. गै to swal-low, शतृ aff.
गिलन: गिलन n. (-नं) Swallowing; also गिरण. E. As before; र changed to ल.
गिलि: गिलि f. (-लिः) 	 1. Swallowing. 	 2. Eating. E. See गिरि, र being changed to ल.
गिलित: गिलित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 	 1. Eaten. 	 2. Swallowed. गॄ to swallow, affix क्त, गिरित, and र changed to ल.
गिष्ण: गिष्ण m. (-ष्णः) 	 1. A Brahman versed in the Sama Veda, a chanter of that Veda, which is always to be so recited. 	 2. An actor, a profes-sional singer.  E. गै to sing, भिष्ण Unadi aff.
गीत: गीत mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Sung, chaunted, sounded, &c. 	 f. (-ता) A name often applied to books, as the Siva Gita, Rama Gita, Gita Govinda, Bhagavad Gita, which last is also often called Gita only. 	 n. (-तं) Singing, song either general or particular.  E. गॄ to sing, affix क्त.
गीतमोदिन्: गीतमोदिन् m. (-दी) A Kinnara or celestial chorister.  E. गीत song or sing-ing, and मोदिन् who delights.
गीति: गीति f. (-तिः) 	 1. Sing, singing, 2. A kind of poetical metre, a form of the Aryya metre, in which the stanza consists of four lines of twelve and eighteen syllabic instants alternately.  E. गै to sing, affix क्तिन्.
गीरथ: गीरथ m. (-थः) A name of VRIHASPATI.  E. गी speech, and रथ a car, the conveyer of words.
गीर्ण: गीर्ण mfn. (-र्णः-र्णा-र्णं) 	 1. Praised. 	 2. Swallowed.  E. गॄ to swallow or make known, affix क्त.
गीर्णि: गीर्णि f. (-र्णिः) 	 1. Swallowing. 	 2. Fame, celebrity. 	 3. Praise, applause E. गृ to swallow, &c. affix क्तिन्.
गीर्देवी: गीर्देवी f. (-वी) The goddess SARASWATI.  E. गी speech, and देवी a goddess, the goddess of language.
गीर्वाण: गीर्व्वाण m. (-णः) A deity, a god.  E. गीः speech, and वाण an arrow or wea-pon in general, whose fiat or word is his weapon; or गी with वन to desire, affix अण्, desiring hymns, prayers, &c. it is also written गीर्ब्बाण.
गीर्व्वाण: गीर्व्वाण m. (-णः) A deity, a god.  E. गीः speech, and वाण an arrow or wea-pon in general, whose fiat or word is his weapon; or गी with वन to desire, affix अण्, desiring hymns, prayers, &c. it is also written गीर्ब्बाण.
गीष्पति: गीष्पति m. (-तिः) 	 1. A name of VRIHASPATI, regent of JUPITER and preceptor of the gods. 	 2. A Pandit or learned teacher.  E. गिर् speech, in the nominative case, गीः and पति master, Visarga becomes स and स is here changed irregularly to ष the compound however is sometimes written differently, thus गीःपति, गीर्पति or गीस्पति.
गु: गु(ओ, शि) r. 6th cl. (गुवति) To stool, to void excrement. (ङ) गुङ् r. 1st cl. (गवते) To sound inarticulately.
गुग्गुल: गुग्गुल m. (-लः) A gum resin: see the next.
गुग्गुलु: गुग्गुलु m. (-लुः) 	 1. A fragrant gum resin, Bdellium or the exudation of the Amyris agallochum. 	 2. A species of morunga, (M. hyperanthe-ra.)  E. गुज् (here said to mean) disease, and गुड to perfume, affixes क and उ, ड change to ल; also गुग्गुल.
गुच्छ: गुच्छ m. (-च्छः) 	 1. A cluster of blossoms. 	 2. A clump of grass. 	 3. A neck-lace of thirty-two strings. 	 4. A pearl necklace. 	 5. A peacock's plumage or bundle of peacock's feathers. 	 6. A bundle. 	 f. (-च्छी) A species of Bonduz: see करञ्ज  E. गु to sound, च्छ affix, or गुध् to play, and च्छक् affix, where bees, &c. sport.
गुच्छक: गुच्छक m. (-कः) 	 1. A cluster of blossoms. 	 2. A clump of grass. 	 3. A kind of necklace. 	 4. A peacock's plumage, a bundle of peacock's feathers. E. कन् added to the preceding; also गुत्सक.
गुच्छपत्र: गुच्छपत्र m. (-त्रः) The palm tree.  E. गुच्छ a cluster, and पत्र a leaf.
गुच्छफला: गुच्छफला f. (-ला) 	 1. The plantain. 	 2. The vine.  E. गुच्छ a cluster, and फला fruit.
गुच्छार्द्ध: गुच्छार्द्ध m. (-र्द्धः) A necklace of thirty-four strings.  E. गुच्छ a large neck-lace, and अर्द्ध a part; also गुत्सार्द्ध.
गुच्छाल: गुच्छाल m. (-लः) A species of grass. (Andropogon schœnanthus.)  E. गुच्छ and अल to fit for, अच् aff.
गुज: गुज r. 1st cl. (गोजति) or (शि) r. 6th cl. (गुजति) or (इ) गुजि r. 1st cl. (गुञ्जति) To sound, to sound inarticulately, to buz, to hum, &c.
गुज्जरी: गुज्जरी f. (-री) One of the Raginis, perhaps more correctly गुर्ज्जरी.
गुञ्ज: गुञ्ज m. (-ञ्जः) A cluster of blossoms, a nosegay. 	 f. (-ञ्जा) 	 1. A small shrub, (Abrus precatorius,) bearing a red and black berry, which forms the smallest of the jeweller's weights. 	 2. The berry which averages about 15-16 grains troy, or the artificial weight called by this name, weighing about 23. 16 grains: see रक्तिका &c. 	 3. A kettle drum. 	 4. A low murmuring sound. 	 5. A tavern. 	 6. Reflection, meditation.  E. गुजि to sound, affix क where the bees buz.
गुञ्जकृत्: गुञ्जकृत् m. (-त्) A large black bee.  E. गुञ्ज a low tone, and कृत् who makes.
गुञ्जत्: गुञ्जत् mfn. (-ञ्जन्-ञ्जन्ती-ञ्जत्) Buzzing, humming, making a low murmuring sound.  E. गुजि to sound, शतृ aff.
गुञ्जन: गुञ्जन n. (-नं) Sounding low and deep, as buzzing, murmuring, &c. E. गुजि to sound, and ल्युट् aff.
गुञ्जिका: गुञ्जिका f. (-का) The Ratti or Gunja seed, considered as equal to three barley-corns: see गुञ्जा  E. गुञ्जा and कन् aff.
गुञ्जित: गुञ्जित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Uttered in a low tone, murmured, &c. 	 n. (-तं) Sounding, murmuring, buzzing.  E. गुजि and क्त aff.
गुटिका: गुटिका f. (-का) 	 1. A pill, a bolus, any small globe or ball. 	 2. A small pustule. 	 3. The cocoon of the silk worm.  E. गुड to surround, affix क्वुन्, ड changed to ट.
गुठ: गुठ (इ) गुठि r. 10th cl. (गुण्ठयति) To surround, to envelope or enclose: with अव, to veil, to screen.
गुड: गुड(शि) r. 6th cl. (गुडति) To defend, to guard or preserve. (इ) गुडि r. 1st and 10th cls. (गुण्डति गुण्डयति) 	 1. To surround, to enclose, 2. To pound, to grind, to reduce to powder. 	 3. (According to some authorities,) To preserve.

गुड mfn. (-डः-डा-डं) Round, globular, m. (-डः) 	 1. A globe or ball. 	 2. Treacle, molasses, the first thickening of the juice of the cane by boiling. 	 3. An elephant's trappings or armour. 	 4. A mouthful. 	 f. (-डा) 1. A plant, (Euphorbia tirucalli:) see स्नुही 2. Powder, pounded substance.  E. गुङ् to sound, affix ड.
गुडक: गुडक m. (-कः) A conserve, a drug prepared with treacle. 	 n. (-कं) Treacle E. गुड and कन् added.
गुडकरी: गुडकरी f. (-री) One of the female personifications of the musical modes.
गुडची: गुडची f. (-ची) A plant, (Menispermum glabrum:) see गुडुची.
गुडतृण: गुडतृण n. (-णं) Sugar cane.  E. गुड raw sugar, and तृण grass.
गुडत्वच्: गुडत्वच् n. (-त्वक्) The aromatic bark of the Laurus cassia.  E. गुड sugar, and त्वच् skin, bark, sweet-bark; also गुडत्वच.
गुडत्वच: गुडत्वच n. (-चं) 	 1. Mace. 	 2. Cassia bark.  E. गुड sugar, sweet as sugar, त्वच् bark, and अच added in this form of the compound.
गुडदारु: गुडदारु m. (-रुः) Sugar cane.  E. गुड raw sugar, and दारु wood.
गुडधेनु: गुडधेनु f. (-नुः) Sugar piled up for distribution at certain religious rites. E. गुड and धेनु a cow.
गुडपिष्ट: गुडपिष्ट n. (-ष्टं) A sort of sweetmeat, flour or rice and sugar, ground and boiled together.  E. गुड and पिष्ट ground.
गुडपुष्प: गुडपुष्प m. (-ष्पः) A kind of bassia, (B. latifolia.)  E. गुड sugar, and पुष्प flower; the flowers being full of saccharine matter.
गुडफल: गुडफल m. (-लः) A tree, commonly Pilu, (Careya arborea, &c.) see पीलु E. गुड and फल fruit, the fruit yielding Gur or saccharine matter.
गुडमिश्र: गुडमिश्र n. (-श्रं) A sort of cake or sweetmeat, flour or rice and coarse sugar ground and boiled together.  E. गुड, and मिश्र mixed.
गुडमूल: गुडमूल m. (-लः) A kind of amaranth, (A. polygamus;) also अल्पमारिष. E. गुड, and मूल root; having a root as sweet as Gur.
गुडल: गुडल n. (-लं) A spirituous liquor distilled from molasses, a sort of rum. E. गुड sugar, and ल what requires.
गुडशर्करा: गुडशर्क्करा f. (-रा) Sugar, refined sugar.  E. गुड molasses, and शर्क्करा sugar or sand.
गुडशर्क्करा: गुडशर्क्करा f. (-रा) Sugar, refined sugar.  E. गुड molasses, and शर्क्करा sugar or sand.
गुडशिग्रु: गुडशिग्रु m. (-ग्रुः) A red sort of morunga: see शोभाञ्जन.  E. गुड sugar, शिग्रु morunga.
गुडाकेश: गुडाकेश m. (-शः) 	 1. A name of SIVA. 	 2. A title of ARJUNA.  E. गुडा Eup-horbia, and केश the hair; the hair forming matted locks, resem-bling in shape the leaves of the Euphorbia: again, गुडिका sloth, and ईश paramount; subduing indolence.
गुडाशय: गुडाशय m. (-यः) A mountain Pilu: see गुडफल.
गुडिका: गुडिका f. (-का) A pill, a bolus.  E. गुड to be round, वुन aff.
गुडुची: गुडुची f. (-ची) A plant: see the next.
गुडूची: गुडूची f. (-ची) A creeper, commonly called Guricha, (Menisperum glab-rum.)  E. गुड to preserve, (from disease,) ऊचट् affix; also with pen. vowel short गुडुची.
गुडेर: गुडेर m. (-रः) A mouthful.  E. गुड to surround, एरक् Unadi aff.
गुडेरक: गुडेरक m. (-कः) A mouthful.  E. गुड to preserve, एरक् affix, and कन् add-ed; also गुडेर.
गुडोद्भवा: गुडोद्भवा f. (-वा) Sugar.  E. गुड, and उद्भव produced.
गुडौदन: गुडौदन n. (-नं) Boiled rice and coarse sugar.  E. गुड, and ओदन rice.
गुण: गुण r. 10th cl. (गुणयति) 	 1. To invite. 	 2. To advise. 	 3. To multiply.

गुण m. (-णः) 	 1. A quality, attribute, or property in general. 	 2. A pro-perty of all created things; three are particularized, the Satwa, Raja and Tama, or principles of truth or existence, passion or foul-ness, and darkness or ignorance. 	 3. A means of defence, one of six expedients in government, as, peace, war, a march, a halt, a stra-tagem, and recourse to protection: see सन्धि &c. 	 4. Form, shape, &c. or property of the body. 	 5. Knowledge, ignorance, &c. or quality of the mind. 	 6. Heroism, valor, &c. 	 7. White, black, &c. or the attributes of color. 	 8. An organ of sense. 	 9. A string in general. 	 10. A bow-string. 	 11. Abandoning, leaving. 	 12. A cook. 	 13. A name of Bhima. 	 14. Secondary subordinate. 	 15. Excellence, merit, free-dom from fault or blemish. 	 16. (In arithmetic,) The given coeffici-ent of any number. 	 17. (In geometry,) The chord of an arc. 	 18. (In grammar,) The substitution of e, o, ar and al for i, u, ri, lri. 	 19. (In rhetoric,) Consistency of plan, elegance of expression, &c. as the merits of a composition. 	 20. In composition with numerals, multiplication, as द्विगुण twice, त्रिगुण thrice. 	 f. (-णा) A plant of the fibers of which bow-strings are made: see मूर्व्वा.  E. गुण to address or advice, affix क्त.
गुणक: गुणक m. (-कः) 	 1. A numerator, reckoner. 	 2. (In arithmetic,) The mul-tiplier.  E. गुण to count, क्कुन् aff.
गुणकार: गुणकार mfn. (-रः-री-रं) Who counts, &c. 	 m. (-रः) A name of BHIMASENA E. गुण and कार who makes; BHIMA performed the duties of a cook at the time when all the Pandava princes become servants to VIRAT.
गुणगान: गुणगान n. (-नं) Panegyric, praise.  E. गुण, and गान singing.
गुणग्रहण: गुणग्रहण n. (-णं) Acknowledging or appreciating merit.  E. गुण, and ग्रहण taking.
गुणग्राहिन्: गुणग्राहिन् mfn. (-ही-हिनी-हि) Who judges or appreciates good qualities, E. गुण and ग्राहिन् who seizes.
गुणगृह्य: गुणगृह्य mfn. (-ह्यः-ह्या-ह्यं) 	 1. Suited to good qualities. 	 2. Admiring or attached to merit.  E. गुण and गृह्य to be caught by.
गुणघातिन्: गुणघातिन् mfn. (-ती-तिनी-ति) A detractor, a calumniator, envious, cen-sorious.  E. गुण and घातिन् who destroys.
गुणज्ञ: गुणज्ञ mfn. (-ज्ञः-ज्ञा-ज्ञं) One who knows how to appreciate men or thing, knowing or judging of their merits.  E. गुण, and ज्ञ who knows.
गुणतस्: गुणतस् ind. 	 1. According to property or quality. 	 2. According to desert. E. गुण, and तसि aff.
गुणता: गुणता f. (-ता) 	 1. Excellence, the possession of good qualities. 	 2. Subs-tantiality, possession of attributes or qualities in general. 	 3. Multiplication.  E. गुण and तल् affix; also with त्व affix गुणत्वं.
गुणत्रय: गुणत्रय n. (-यं) The three properties of nature; purity, passion, and darkness.  E. गुण and त्रय triple; also गुणत्रितयं.
गुणदोषपरीक्षण: गुणदोषपरीक्षण n. (-णं) Test or investigation of merits and faults.  E. गुण, दोष fault, परीक्षण trying.
गुणधर्म: गुणधर्म्म m. (-र्म्मः) The virtue incident to the possession of certain qualities, as clemency is the virtue of royalty, &c.  E. गुण a property, and धर्म्म virtue.
गुणधर्म्म: गुणधर्म्म m. (-र्म्मः) The virtue incident to the possession of certain qualities, as clemency is the virtue of royalty, &c.  E. गुण a property, and धर्म्म virtue.
गुणन: गुणन n. (-नं) 	 1. Describing, relating to qualities. 	 2. Enumerating. 	 3. Mulitiplication.  E. गुण to number, ल्युट् aff.

गुणहीन: गुणहीन mfn. (-नः-ना-नं) 	 1. Void of merit. 	 2. Free from properties.  E. गुण, and हीन void of.

गुणोत्कीर्तन: गुणोत्कीर्त्तन n. (-नं) Panegyric, eulogium.  E. गुण and उत्कीर्त्तन celebrating.

गुणोत्कृष्ट: गुणोत्कृष्ट mfn. (-ष्टः-ष्टा-ष्टं) Superior in merit or in good qualities.  E. गुण, and उत्कृष्ट best.
गुणोपेत: गुणोपेत mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Endowed with good qualities.  E. गुण and उपेत possessed of.

गुरुहन्: गुरुहन् m. (-हा) The murderer of his Guru or spiritual parent.  E. गरु and हन् who kills, from हन् with क्विप् affix; this is the most hein-ous of all criminals, according to Hindu notions.
गुर्जर: गुर्ज्जर m. (-रः) The name of a district, Gurjara or Guzrat. plu. 	 m. (-राः) The people of Guzrat. 	 f. (-री) One of the Raginis or female personifications of music.
गुर्ज्जर: गुर्ज्जर m. (-रः) The name of a district, Gurjara or Guzrat. plu. 	 m. (-राः) The people of Guzrat. 	 f. (-री) One of the Raginis or female personifications of music.
गुर्द: गुर्द r. 1st. cl. (गुर्दते or गूर्दते) To play. r. 10th cl. (गुर्दयति or गूर्दयति) 	 1. To dwell or inhabit. 	 2. To invite.
गुर्व: गुर्व r. 1st cl. (ई)गुर्वी (गुर्वति) To endeavor, to aim or strive.

गुर्व्वर्थम्: गुर्व्वर्थम् ind. For or on account of a Guru.  E. गुरु, and अर्थ object.
गुर्वङ्गना: गुर्व्वङ्गना f. (-ना) 	 1. The wife of a Guru. 	 2. Any woman entitled to great respect.  E. गुरु, and अङ्गना a female.
गुर्व्वङ्गना: गुर्व्वङ्गना f. (-ना) 	 1. The wife of a Guru. 	 2. Any woman entitled to great respect.  E. गुरु, and अङ्गना a female.
गुर्विणी: गुर्व्विणी f. (-णी) A pregnant woman.  E. गर्व्व to be proud, Unadi affix इनच् and ङीष् fem. affix, उ substituted for the radical अ; also गर्भिणी.
गुर्व्विणी: गुर्व्विणी f. (-णी) A pregnant woman.  E. गर्व्व to be proud, Unadi affix इनच् and ङीष् fem. affix, उ substituted for the radical अ; also गर्भिणी.
गुर्वी: गुर्व्वी f. (-र्व्वीं) 	 1. A pregnant woman. 	 2. The wife of a Guru or spiritual teacher.  E. गुरु heavy, &c. and ङीष् aff.
गुर्व्वी: गुर्व्वी f. (-र्व्वीं) 	 1. A pregnant woman. 	 2. The wife of a Guru or spiritual teacher.  E. गुरु heavy, &c. and ङीष् aff.
गुल: गुल m. (-लः) Raw unrefined sugar, molasses. 	 f. (-ला) A plant, (Euphor-bia tirucalli:) see स्नुही. (-ली) 1. A pill, a bolus, any small globu-lar substance. 	 2. Small pox.  E. गुड to surround, &c. affixes क and and टाप्, or ङीष्, ड changed to ल.

गुलिका: गुलिका f. (-का) A small ball.  E. कन् added to गुली.
गुलिकाक्रीडा: गुलिकाक्रीडा f. (-डा) Playing with a ball, bat and ball, golf, &c.  E. गुलिका and क्रीडा play.
गुलुच्छ: गुलुच्छ m. (-च्छः) A cluster of blossoms; also गुलुञ्छ.

गुल्फ: गुल्फ m. (-ल्फः) The ankle.  E. गल् to go, affix फक्, and उ substituted for the penultimate.
गुल्म: गुल्म m. (-ल्मः) 	 1. The division of an army, a body of troops, consisting of nine platoons, or nine elephants, nine chariots, twenty-seven horse, and forty-five foot. 	 2. The spleen. 	 3.
