(-ल्मी) 	 1. A tent. 	 2. Emblic myrobalan also आमलकी. 	 3. Small cardamoms: see एला. 	 4. A cluster or clump of trees, a multitude of thickets. 	 5. A kind of plant, commonly Kurkavali.  E. गुड to surround, मक् affix, ड changed to ल.
गुल्मकेतु: गुल्मकेतु m. (-तुः) A small sort of cane or reed.  E. गुल्म and केतु banner.
गुल्ममूल: गुल्ममूल n. (-लं) Ginger.  E. गुल्म and मूल a root.
गुल्मिन्: गुल्मिन् mfn. (-ल्मी-ल्मिनी-ल्मि) 	 1. Composed of different divisions, (a force, &c.) 	 2. Growing, &c. in a clump or cluster. 	 3. Having the spleen affected by it. 	 f. (-नी) A spreading creeper or any creeping plant. E. गुल्म a clump, इनि and ङीष् affs.
गुल्य: गुल्य m. (-ल्यः) Sweetness, a sweet or saccharine taste.  E. गुड molasses, and क्यप् affix; ड changed to ल.
गुवाक: गुवाक m. (-कः) The betelnut tree, (Areca faufel or catechu.)  E. गु to stool, affix आक, and उ converted to उव irregularly.
गुह: गुह r. 1st cl. (ऊ)गुहू(गुहति) To cover, to cover as with clothes. to wear.

गुह m. (-ह) 	 1. A name of KARTIKEYA. 	 2. A name of VISHNU. 	 3. A swift horse. 	 4. The name of Nishada, ruler of Sringavera, the friend of RAMA. 	 5. A name or title proper to persons of the writer caste. 	 f. (-हा) 	 1. A cave, a cavern. 	 2. A pit, a hole in the ground. 	 3. A plant, commonly Chakuliya: see सिंहपुच्छी.  E. गुह to conceal, affixes अङ् and टाप.
गुहागृह: गुहागृह n. (-हं) A cavern.  E. गुहा, and गृह a house.
गुहामुख: गुहामुख mfn. (-खः-खी-खं) Wide mouthed, open mouthed.  E. गुहा, and मुख mouth.
गुहाशय: गुहाशय m. (-यः) 	 1. A tiger. 	 2. Any animal or man living in caverns. 	 3. A name of VISHNU.  E. गुहा a cave, and आशय abode.
गुहिन: गुहिन n. (-नं) A wood, a thicket.  E. गुह् to hide, इनच् aff.
गुहिल: गुहिल n. (-लं) Wealth, property.  E. गुह् to hide, &c. इलच् aff.
गुहेर: गुहेर m. (-रः) 	 1. An iron-smith. 	 2. A guardian, a preserver.  E. गुह to cover, एरक् Unadi aff.
गुह्य: गुह्य mfn. (-ह्यः-ह्या-ह्यं) 	 1. Secret, solitary, retired. 	 2. Private, concealable, to be kept hidden or secret. 	 3. Mysterious, mystical. 	 m. (-ह्यः) 	 1. A tortoise. 	 2. Hypocrisy. 	 3. VISHNU. 	 n. (-ह्यं) 	 1. A privity, an organ of generation, &c. 	 2. The anus.  E. गुह् to cover, क्य affix, deriv. irr.
गुह्यक: गुह्यक m. (-कः) A kind of demigod attendant upon KUVERA the deity of wealth, and guardian of his treasures.  E. गुह् to preserve or conceal, affix क्वुन् and य inserted.
गुह्यकेश्वर: गुह्यकेश्वर m. (-रः) A name of KUVERA the Hindu PLUTUS.  E. गुह्यक a demigod, (see the preceding,) and ईश्वर lord or master.
गुह्यगुरु: गुह्यगुरु m. (-रुः) A name of SIVA.  E. गुह्य secret, and गुरु a master; SIVA being considered as a teacher, especially of the Tantras or Hindu mystic and magical works.
गुह्यदीपक: गुह्यदीपक m. (-कः) The fire fly.  E. गुह्य a solitary place, and दीपक the illuminer; from दीप् to light or inflame, and क्वन् aff.
गुह्यनिष्यन्द: गुह्यनिष्यन्द m. (-न्दः) Urine.  E. गुह्य and निष्यन्द what flows.
गुह्यभाषित: गुह्यभाषित n. (-तं) 	 1. A Mantra, a mystical prayer or incantation 2. A secret.  E. गुह्य secret.  E. भाषित spoken.

गूढ: गूढ mfn. (-ढः-ढा-ढं) Hidden, concealed. 	 n. (-ढं) 	 1. A solitary or private place. 	 2. A private part. 	 3. A mystery.  E. गुह् to hide, affix क्त. deriv. irregular.
गूढचार: गूढचार mfn. (-रः-रा-रं) One who goes about privately. 	 m. (-रः) A secret emissary.  E. गूढ and चार practice.
गूढचारिन्: गूढचारिन् m. (-री) A secret emissary, a spy.  E. गूढ and चारिन् who goes.
गूढज: गूढज m. (-जः) The son of a concealed birth; born privately of a woman whose husband is absent, the real father being unknown; this is one of the twelve forms particularized in Hindu law.  E. गूढ hidden, and ज born; also compound with पुत्त्र a son, गूढजपुत्त्र.
गूढनीड: गूढनीड m. (-डः) The wagtail.  E. गूड secret, and नीड a nest.

गूढपुरुष: गूढपुरुष m. (-षः) A spy, a secret emissary, a disguised agent, &c.  E. गूढ concealed, and पुरुष a man.
गूढभाषित: गूढभाषित n. (-तं) Secret intelligence, private communication.  E. गूढ secret, and भाषित what is said.
गूढमार्ग: गूढमार्ग m. (-र्गः) A subterraneous passage, a defile, a bye-road, or secret way.  E. गूढ concealed, and मार्ग a road.
गूढमैथुन: गूढमैथुन m. (-नः) A crow.  E. गूढ secret, and मैथुन copulation.

गूढवर्च्चस्: गूढवर्च्चस् m. (-र्च्चाः) A frog.  E. गूढ hidden, and वर्च्चस् light, warmth; perhaps an idea is implied analogous to that of cold blooded animals: some explain it वर्च्चस् fœces, whose excrement is unknown.

गूढाङ्ग: गूढाङ्ग m. (-ङ्गः) A tortoise.  E. गूढ, and अङ्ग body, hidden in his shell.

गून: गून mfn. (-नः-ना-नं) Voided, (as ordure.)  E. गू to stool, affix क्त deriv. irr.

गृज: गृज r. 1st cl. (गर्जति) also (इ,) गृजि (गृञ्जति) To sound, to roar, to grum-ble, &c. also गर्ज.

गृहकार्य: गृहकार्य्य n. (-र्य्यं) Household affairs.  E. गृह, and कार्य्य business; also गृह-कर्म्म, &c.
गृहकार्य्य: गृहकार्य्य n. (-र्य्यं) Household affairs.  E. गृह, and कार्य्य business; also गृह-कर्म्म, &c.
गृहगोधा: गृहगोधा f. (-धा) A small house lizard.  E. गृह a house, and गोधा or गोधिका an iguana; hence also गृहगोधिका, or ध being changed to ल, गृह-गोलिका.
गृहगोलिका: गृहगोलिका f. (-का) A lizard: see the preceding.
गृहचटक: गृहचटक m. (-कः) A house sparrow.  E. गृह and चटक a sparrow.

गृहज: गृहज mfn. (-जः-जा-जं) Born in the house. 	 m. (-जः) A slave born in the house.  E. गृह, and ज born; also गृहजात.

गृहद्वार: गृहद्वार m. (-रः) The door of a house.  E. गृह, and द्वार a door.
गृहद्रुम: गृहद्रुम m. (-मः) A plant commonly Medhasringi: see मेढशृङ्गी  E. गृह a house, द्रुम a tree, growing near dwellings.
गृहनाशन: गृहनाशन m. (-नः) A pigeon.  E. गृह, and नाशन who injures; defacing the walls of a house by building in and about it.
गृहनीड: गृहनीड m. (-डः) A sparrow.  E. गृह and नीड a nest, who builds his nest in human dwellings.
गृहपति: गृहपति m. (-तिः) 	 1. A house. holder, a man of the second class, or who after having finished his studies is married and settled. 	 2. A house holder of particular merit, giving alms, and performing all the prescribed ceremonies, &c. 	 3. Maintenance of a sacred and perpe-tual fire. 	 4. Virtue, especially of a householder, as hospitality, &c. E. गृह a house. and पति lord or master.
गृहपोतक: गृहपोतक m. (-कः) The site of a habitation, the ground on which it stands, and which is attached to it.  E. गृह, and पोत a young ani-mal, affix कन्, the rudiments of the house.
गृहबलि: गृहबलि m. (-लिः) Offering of the reliques of a meal, or sacrifice to the spirits of the air, &c.  E. गृह, and बलि offering.
गृहबलिप्रिय: गृहबलिप्रिय m. (-यः) A kind of crane, the Vaca.  E. गृह a house, बलि food offered in oblation, and प्रिय fond of: see the next.
गृहबलिभुज्: गृहबलिभुज् m. (-भुक्) 	 1. A sparrow. 	 2. A kind of crane. (Ardea nivea.) 3. A crow.  E. गृह a house or a wife, बलि grain, &c. used in obla-tions, or any edible grain, and भुज् who eats; that is, who eats the food of his female, or the fragments of offerings fallen in or about the house; also गृहबलिप्रिय.
गृहभङ्ग: गृहभङ्ग m. (-ङ्गः) 	 1. An exile, one who is driven from his house. 	 2. Fa-mily decay. 	 3. Breaking down or into a house.  E. गृह, and भङ्ग breaking.
गृहभञ्जन: गृहभञ्जन n. (-नं) 	 1. Breaking down or destroying a house. 	 2. Causing the ruin or decay of a family.  E. गृह, and भञ्जन breaking.
गृहभूमि: गृहभूमि f. (-मिः) The site of a habitation.  E. गृह a house, and भूमि ground.
गृहमणि: गृहमणि m. (-णिः) A lamp.  E. गृह a house, and मणि a jewel.
गृहमाचिका: गृहमाचिका f. (-का) A bat.  E. गृह a house, and माचिका a fly.
गृहमृग: गृहमृग m. (-गः) A dog.  E. गृह a house, and मृग a deer.
गृहमेधिन्: गृहमेधिन् m. (-धी) A householder. 	 f. (-धिनी) 	 1. A housewife, the wife of a householder. 	 2. Natural sense or intelligence,  E. गृह a house, मेध to to understand, and इनि aff.
गृहयाप्य: गृहयाप्य m. (-प्यः) The householder, the master of a house or family. E. गृह to take, याप्य Unadi affix, and अय inserted.
गृहयालु: गृहयालु mfn. (-लुः-लुः-लु) Disposed to seize or take.  E. गृह to take, अय inserted, and आलच् aff.
गृहरन्ध्र: गृहरन्ध्र n. (-न्ध्रं) 	 1. Private or family affairs, especially of an unpleas-ing nature. 	 2. A breach in the wall of a house.  E. गृह, and रन्ध्र a a hole; also गृहछिद्रं.
गृहवाटिका: गृहवाटिका f. (-का) A garden or grove near a house.  E. गृह a house, वट् to surround, affix ण्वुल्, and fem form.
गृहव्यापार: गृहव्यापार m. (-रः) Household affairs, domestic economy.  E. गृह and व्यापार practice.
गृहस्तम्भ: गृहस्तम्भ m. (-म्भः) The pillar of a house.  E. गृह, and स्तम्भ a post.
गृहस्थ: गृहस्थ m. (-स्थः) A householder, the man of the second class, or he who, after having finished his studies, and been invested with the sacred thread, performs the duties of the master of a house, and father of a family.  E. गृह a house, and स्थ who stays or abides.
गृहस्थधर्म: गृहस्थधर्म्म m. (-र्म्मः) The practice or duty of a householder.  E. गृहस्थ and धर्म्म duty.
गृहस्थधर्म्म: गृहस्थधर्म्म m. (-र्म्मः) The practice or duty of a householder.  E. गृहस्थ and धर्म्म duty.
गृहस्थाश्रम: गृहस्थाश्रम m. (-मः) The order of householder.  E. गृहस्थ, and आश्रम order of life.
गृहस्थूण: गृहस्थूण n. (-णं) The pillar of a house.  E. गृह a house, and स्थूण a prop or pillar.
गृहाक्ष: गृहाक्ष m. (-क्षः) A loophole, an eyelet hole, a round or oblong window. E. गृह a house, and अक्ष for अक्षि an eye.
गृहागत: गृहागत m. (-तः) A guest.  E. गृह, and आगत come to.
गृहाधिप: गृहाधिप m. (-पः) The Grihastha or householder; see गृहस्थ.  E. गृह a house, and अधिप a master.
गृहाभिपालिन्: गृहाभिपालिन् mfn. (-ली-लिनी-लि) Watching, taking care of the house. 	 m. (-ली) A watchman.  E. गृह and अभि before पाल to protect, णिनि aff.
गृहाम्ल: गृहाम्ल n. (-म्लं) Sour gruel, made from the fermentation of rice water. E. गृह a house, अम्ल sour, the domestic acid.
गृहायणिक: गृहायणिक m. (-कः) A householder.  E. गृह a house, फिञ् derivative affix, and कन् added.
गृहाराम: गृहाराम m. (-मः) A garden, a grove, &c. near a house.  E. गृह a house, and आराम a garden.
गृहालिका: गृहालिका f. (-का) A small lizard.  E. गृह a house, आलि a scorpion, कन् affix of similitude.
गृहावग्रहणी: गृहावग्रहणी f. (-णी) The threshold, a raised ground or terrace in front of the door.  E. गृह a house, and अव prefixed to ग्रह to take, affixes ल्युट् and ङीप्.
गृहावस्थित: गृहावस्थित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 	 1. Dwelling or living in a house. 	 2. Lying in any place.  E. गृह, and अवस्थित placed or situated in.
गृहाशया: गृहाशया f. (-या) The betel tree, (Piper betel.)  E. गृह a house, &c. आशय an asylum growing near dwellings.
गृहाश्मन्: गृहाश्मन् m. (-श्मा) A flat oblong stone, upon which condiments are ground together.  E. गृह a house, and अश्मन् a stone.
गृहिणी: गृहिणी f. (-णी) A wife.  E. गृह a house, and इनि and ङीष् affs.
गृहिन्: गृहिन् m. (-ही) A householder.  E. गृह a house, and इनि aff.
गृहीत: गृहीत mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 	 1. Taken, attached, seized, caught. 	 2. Obtained. 3. Known, understood. 	 4. Promised, agreed. 	 5. Learnt, acquired. E. ग्रह् to take, affix क्त, र changed to ऋ.
गृहीतविद्य: गृहीतविद्य mfn. (-द्यः-द्या-द्यं) Versed in science, learned, studied.  E. गृहीत, and विद्या learning.
गृहीतदिश्: गृहीतदिश् mfn. (-दिक्) Flown. escaped, retreated.  E. गृहीत seized, and दिश् place.
गृहीतवेतन: गृहीतवेतन mfn. (-नः-ना-नं) Paid, remunerated.  E. गृहीत and वेतन wages.
गृहीतृ: गृहीतृ mfn. (-ता-त्री-तृ) Taking, disposed to seize or take.  E. ग्रह to seize, affix तृच् and ई inserted.
गृहीत्वा: गृहीत्वा ind. Having taken.  E. ग्रह to take, क्त्वा aff.
गृहोपकरण: गृहोपकरण n. (-णं) Any domestic utensil.  E. गृह and उपकरण instrument.
गृहोत्पात: गृहोत्पात m. (-तः) 	 1. A domestic nuisance, as vermin, &c. 	 2. Family mis-fortune.  E. गृह, and उत्पात calamity.
गृहोलिका: गृहोलिका f. (-का) A small house lizard.  E. गृह to take, and उल and कन् affixes: see गृहगोधिका.
गृह्णत्: गृह्णत् mfn. (-ह्णन्-ह्णन्ती-ह्णत्) Taking, seizing, accepting, &c.  E. ग्रह् to take, शतृ aff.
गृह्य: गृह्य mfn. (-ह्यः-ह्या-ह्यं) 	 1. Dependent, subservient. 	 2. A partisan of or belonging to a side or party. 	 3. To be taken or seized. 	 4. To be trusted to, to be relied on. 	 5. To be acknowledged or admitted, to be adopted as faith or belief. 	 5. Domestic, of or belonging to a house. 	 m. (-ह्यः) A tame or domesticated animal. 	 n. (-ह्यं) 	 1. The name of a book, containing directions for religious rites, a section or component treatise of the Sama Veda, by GOBHILA and others; which contains rules for the performance of domestic and other ceremonies: the ritual of the Vedas. 	 f. (-ह्या) A suburb, a village ad-joining to a city, or a small village attached to a larger.  E. ग्रह or गृह to take, affix क्यप्; or गृह a house, यत् affix; also with कन् add-ed गृह्यक.
गृह्यक: गृह्यक mfn. (-कः-का-कं) Dependent, docile, not following one's own in-clinations. 	 m. (-कः) A tame or domesticated animal, whether a bird or beast, &c.  E. गृध् for ग्रह् to take, क्यप् affix, and कन् added.
गृह्यगुरु: गृह्यगुरु m. (-रुः) A name of SIVA.  E. गृह्य, and गुरु a teacher.
गृह्यसूत्र: गृह्यसूत्र n. (-त्रं) A precept of the Grihya or ritual of the Vedas.  E. गृह्य, and सूत्र a rule.
गॄ: गॄ r. 6th cl. (गिरति or गिलति) To swallow, to eat. r. 9th cl. (गृणाति) To sound, to sound intelligibly or articulately, to speak. r. 10th cl. (गीरयते) 	 1. To know. 	 2. To make known, to teach. With निर् or उत् prefixed, To reject, to vomit. With सम् and उत्, 1. To throw up. 	 2. To cry aloud.
गेण्डु: गेण्डु m. (-ण्डुः) A ball for playing with.  E. गा to go, affix इण्डु, or with कन् added गेण्डुक.
गेण्डुक: गेण्डुक m. (-कः) A ball; also गेण्डूक, the penultimate being made long.
गेप: गेप r. 1st cl. (ऋ)गेवृ (गेपते) 1. To shake or tremble. 	 2. To move.
गेय: गेय mfn. (-यः-या-यं) 	 1. A singer. 	 2. A song or chaunt, what is to be sung or chaunted. 	 n. (-यं) Song, singing.  E. गै to sing, affix यत्.
गेव: गेव r. 1st cl. (ऋ) गेवृ(गेवते) To serve, to gratify by service.
गेष: गेष r. 1st cl. (ऋ)गेषृ(गेषते) To seek, to search, to investigate.
गेष्ण: गेष्ण m. (-ष्णः) 	 1. A professional singer, an actor, a mime, &c. 	 2. A chaun-ter of the Sama Veda.  E. गै to sing, and इष्णच् Unadi aff.
गेष्णु: गेष्णु m. (-ष्णुः) 	 1. A singer. 	 2. An actor. 	 3. A chaunter of the Sama Veda: see गेष्ण  E. गै to sing, and इष्णुच् Unadi aff.
गेह: गेह n. (-हं) A house, a dwelling.  E. ग a name of GANESHA इह् to desire, affix घञ्; that deity being usually invoked upon laying the found-ations of a house.
गेहनर्द्दिन्: गेहनर्द्दिन् m. (-र्द्दी) A lazy or effeminate man, a cotquean.  E. गेह a house, and नर्द्दिन् who makes a noise: see the next.
गेहशूर: गेहशूर m. (-रः) A slothful and trifling man, one who is unfit for con-cerns beyond those of the house, a cotquean, a house-hero.  E. गेह a house, and शूर a hero.
गेहिन्: गेहिन् mfn. (-ही-हिनी-हि) Having a house, householder, &c.  E. गेह, and इनि aff.
गै: गै r. 1st cl. (गायति) To sound, to sing. With उद् or प्र prefixed; (उद्गायति प्रगायति) To sing, to chaunt, to sing out or aloud. (उद्गीयते प्रगीयते) To be sung or chaunted. With वि (विगायति) To assert repeatedly.
गैर: गैर mfn. (-रः-री-रं) Mountain, mountaineer, mountain-born.  E. गिरि, and अण् aff.
गैरिक: गैरिक mfn. (-कः-की-कं) Mountain, mountain-born or produced n. (-कं) 	 1. Red chalk, or as sometimes applied, red orpiment. 	 2. Gold.  E. गिरि a mountain, affix ठक्.
गैरेय: गैरेय mfn. (-यः-यी-यं) Mountain, mountaineer, mountain-born. 	 n. (-यं) 	 1. Bitumen. 	 2. Red chalk.  E. गिरि a mountain, affix ढक्.
गो: गो m. (-गौः) 	 1. Heaven, Swarga or paradise. 	 2. A bull. 	 3. A ray of light. 4. The thunderbolt. 	 5. The moon. 	 6. The sun. 	 7. A kind of sacri-fice, the sacrifice of a cow. 	 8. The moment of the sun's entering Taurus. mn (-गौः-गु) 	 1. The hair of the body. 	 2. Water: (in the last sense some confine it to the mas. plu. गावः and according to others, it is neuter in several other senses.) 	 f. (-गौः) 	 1. A cow. 	 2. The eye. 3. An arrow. 	 4. quarter, as the east, west, &c. 	 5. Speech; also identi-fied with the goddess of speech. SARASWATI. 	 6. The earth. 	 7. A mother.  E. गम् to go, and करणे डो Unadi aff. गच्छति अनेन ।
गोकण्टक: गोकण्टक m. (-कः) 	 1. The name of a plant: see गोखुर. 	 2. The print of a cow's hoof or spot so marked.  E. गो the earth or a cow, &c. and कण्टक a thorn. गोः पृथिव्याः कण्टक इव ।
गोकर्ण: गोकर्ण m. (-र्णः) 	 1. A span from the tip of the thumb to that of the little finger. 	 2. A kind of deer, (the Nilgau) 	 3. A mule. 	 4. A class of demigods. 	 5. A kind of snake. 	 6. A snake in general. 	 7. A place of pilgrimage on the Malabar coast. 	 f. (-र्णी) A plant, (Aletris hyacin-thoides:) see मूर्व्वा.  E. गो a cow, and कर्ण an ear, having ears like a cow, &c. गौः नेत्रं कर्णौ यस्य ।
गोकिराटिका: गोकिराटिका f. (-का) A bird, considered as one kind of the common Maina, (Turdus salica.)  E. गो the earth, and किर a hog, अट who goes, with कन् added in the fem. form; resembling a hog, feeding on ordure, &c.
गोकिल: गोकिल m. (-लः) 	 1. A plough. 	 2. A pestle.  E. गो the earth, and किल् to go. affix क; also गोकील.
गोकील: गोकील m. (-लः) 	 1. A pestle. 	 2. A plough.  E. गो the earth, and कील a pin or bolt. गोः पृथिव्याः कील इव ।
गोकुल: गोकुल n. (-लं) 	 1. A herd of kine, a multitude of cattle. 	 2. A cow-house or station. 	 3. A village or tract on the Jumna, the residence of NANDA and of KRISHNA during his youth. 	 n. गो a cow, and कुल an assemblage.
गोकुलिक: गोकुलिक mfn. (-कः-का-कं) 	 1. Squint-eyed. 	 2. One who does not give help to a cow in the mud.  E. गो the eye, &c. and कुल् to accumulate, affix ठक्.
गोकृत: गोकृत n. (-तं) Cowdung.  E. गो a cow, and कृत made.
गोक्षुर: गोक्षुर m. (-रः) The name of a plant; also Gokhura, (Ruellia longifolia, Rox, it is also applied in Bengal to Tribulus lanuginosus.) 	 n. (-रं) A cow's hoof.  E. गो a cow, and क्षुर a hoof, the thorns getting be-tween the hoofs of cattle; also with कन् added गोक्षुरक, and with खुर a hoof, गोखुर.
गोखुर: गोखुर m. (-रः) See गोक्षुर; also गोखुरि.
गोगोयुग: गोगोयुग n. (-गं) A pair of oxen.  E. गो, and गोयुग a pair. गवोर्द्वित्वम् ।
गोगोष्ठ: गोगोष्ठ n. (-ष्ठं) A cattle shed.  E. गो, and गोष्ठ a shed. गोः स्थानम् गा + स्थाने गोष्ठच् ।
गोगृष्टि: गोगृष्टि f. (-ष्टिः) A cow that has had one calf.  E. गो a cow, and गृष्टि q. v. the same as the compound. सकृत् प्रमूतायां गवि ।
गोग्रन्थि: गोग्रन्थि m. (-न्थिः) 	 1. Dried cow-dung. 	 2. A station for cows, a cow-yard or house, &c.  E. गो a cow, ग्रन्थ् to arrange, and इन् aff. गोर्जातो ग्रन्थिः ।
गोग्रह: गोग्रह m. (-हः) Spoil, booty, capture of cattle.  E. गो, and ग्रह seizing.
गोग्रास: गोग्रास m. (-सः) The ceremony of presenting grass to the cow when making atonement.  E. गो, and ग्रास a mouthful.
गोघ्न: गोघ्न mfn. (-घ्नः-घ्नी-घ्नं) Who or what kills kine. 	 m. (-घ्नः) A guest.  E. गो a cow, and घ्न what kills, from हन् with क affix; a cow being killed on the arrival of the latter, or being presented to him.
गोघृत: गोघृत n. (-तं) 	 1. Rain. 	 3. Ghee made from cow's milk.  E. गो the earth, घृत what sprinkles, from घृ to sprinkle or wet, affix क्त.
गोचर: गोचर m. (-रः) 	 1. An object of sense, as sound, shape, colour, &c. 	 2. A. country, a district. 	 3. The house or mansion of a planet, or its presence in any sign which is that of a person's nativity. 	 4. Pas-turage.  E. गो an organ of sense, &c. and चर what goes, from चर् to go, निपातने अच् aff.
गोचर्मन्: गोचर्म्मन् n. (-र्म्म) 	 1. A cow's hide. 	 2. A hide of land, 300 feet long, by 10 broad: it is also defined as that extent of land, the crop of which will support a man for a year.  E. गो and चर्म्मन् skin.
गोचर्म्मन्: गोचर्म्मन् n. (-र्म्म) 	 1. A cow's hide. 	 2. A hide of land, 300 feet long, by 10 broad: it is also defined as that extent of land, the crop of which will support a man for a year.  E. गो and चर्म्मन् skin.
गोचारक: गोचारक m. (-कः) A cowhered.  E. गो, चर to go, causal form णिच् ण्वुल् aff.
गोच्छाल: गोछाल m. (-लः) The palm of the hand with the fingers extended, &c. see अलम्बुष. गां भूमिम् आच्छादयति छद-णिच् अण् पृषोदरादित्वात् । भूकदम्बे । चाकुलिया ।
गोछाल: गोछाल m. (-लः) The palm of the hand with the fingers extended, &c. see अलम्बुष. गां भूमिम् आच्छादयति छद-णिच् अण् पृषोदरादित्वात् । भूकदम्बे । चाकुलिया ।
गोजल: गोजल n. (-लं) Cow's urine.  E. गो, and जल water. गवि जातं जलम् ।
गोजागरिक: गोजागरिक m. (-कः) A prickly nightshade. 	 n. (-कं) Happy, fortunate, auspicious.  E. गो the earth, जागृ to wake or to be awake, affix ठक्.
गोजिह्वा: गोजिह्वा f. (-ह्वा) A potherb growing wild. (Elephantophus scaber.)  E. गो a cow, and जिह्वा a tongue: the leaves being so compared; also with कन् added गोजिह्वका.

गोडुम्ब: गोडुम्ब mf. (-म्बः-म्बा) The water melon. 	 f. (-म्बा) A kind of cucumber, (Cucumis madras patanus.)  E. गो the earth, तुवि to hurt, affix क and त changed to ड. गां भूमिं तुम्बति अर्दति । तुवि-क पृषोदराः ।
गोणी: गोणी f. (-णी) 	 1. Torn or ragged clothes. 	 2. A sack. 	 3. The measure of a Drona.  E. गुण् to reckon, affixes घञ् नि-गुणः and ङीष् the deriv. irr.

गोतम: गोतम m. (-मः) The name of a sage belonging to the family of ANGIRAS father of SATANANDA; also गौतम. गोभिस्तमो ध्वस्तं यस्य पृषोदरादित्वात् ।
गोतमान्वय: गोतमान्वय m. (-यः) A name of SAKYA or SAKYA MUNI, a Bauddha sage. E. गोतम a sage, and अन्वय lineage; the descendant of GOTAMA.
गोतल्लज: गोतल्लज m. (-जः) An excellent cow.  E. गो a cow, तल्लज implying excellence.
गोत्र: गोत्र n. (-त्रं) 	 1. Family, race, lineage, kin. 	 2. A name, an appellation. 	 3. A forest. 	 4. A field. 	 5. A Chhattra, an umbrella or parasol. 	 6. A road. 7. Knowledge of futurity, inspiration. 	 8. A genus, a class or species 9. A caste, a tribe or subdivision of it into families, as in that of the Brahman; twenty-four Gotras are reckoned, supposed to be sprung from and named after celebrated teachers, as SANDILYA, KASYAPA, GAUTAMA, BHARADWAJA, &c. 	 10. Increase. 	 11. Wealth. f. (-त्रा) 	 1. The earth. 	 2. A herd of kine. 	 m. (-त्रः) A mountain. गोत्रज: गोत्रज mf. (-जः-जा) A relation: in law, the term is nearly equivalent to the Gentile of Roman law, and is applied to kindred of the same general family, who are connected by offerings of food and water, and stands opposed to the Bandhu or cognate kin, who do not partake in the offerings to the common ancestors: see बन्धु.  E. गोत्र as above, ज born. गोत्रे समाने वंशे जायते जन-ड ।
गोत्रभिद्: गोत्रभिद् m. (-भिद्- or भित्) A name of INDRA.  E. गोत्र a mountain, and भिद् who splits, (with his thunderbolt.) गोत्रं पर्वतं मेघं वा भिनत्ति । भिद्-क्विप् ।
गोत्ररिवथ: गोत्ररिवथ n. (-क्थं) Patrimony, inheritance.  E. गोत्र, and रिवथ wealth.
गोद: गोद mfn. (-दः-दा-दं) Who or what gives a cow. 	 m. (-दः) The brain.  E. गो light or a cow, and द what gives. गां नेत्रं दायति शोधयति दै-क ।
गोदन्त: गोदन्त m. (-न्तः) 	 1. Yellow orpiment. 	 2. A cow's tooth. 	 3. A fossile subs-tance of a white colour, apparently an earthy salt.  E. गो a cow, and दन्त a tooth, a cow's tooth, from its similar hardness, &c.
गोदा: गोदा f. (-दा) The Godavari river.  E. गो water, and द who gives; see गोदावरी. गां स्वर्गं ददाति स्नानेन दा-क ।
गोदान: गोदान n. (-नं) Gift of a cow.  E. गो, and दान gift; or केशान्ताख्ये संस्कारभेदे also गोप्रदान गावः केशलोमानि वा दीयन्ते खण्ड्यन्ते अत्र । आधारे ल्युट् ।
गोदारण: गोदारण n. (-णं) 	 1. A plough. 	 2. A spade or hoe,  E. गो the earth, and दारण what cuts or tears. गां भूमिं दारयति दृ-णिच्-ल्यु ।
गोदावरी: गोदावरी f. (-री) The name of a river in the peninsula, the Godavari. E, गो water, and द what gives, गोद and आवृ to cover or conceal; affixes अप् and ङीप्. गां स्वर्गं ददाति स्नानात् दा वनिप् ङीप् ।
गोदुग्ध: गोदुग्ध n. (-ग्धं) Cow's milk.  E. गो, and दुग्ध milk.
गोदुह: गोदुह m. (-धुक्) A cowherd, a milkman.  E. गो a cow, दुह to milk, and क्विप् affix; also with क affix गोदुह, nom. (-हः).
गोदोहनी: गोदोहनी f. (-नी) A milk pail.  E. गो a cow, and दुह to milk, with भावे ल्युट् and ङीप् aff. आधारे ल्युट् गोदोहनकाले ।
गोद्रव: गोद्रव m. (-वः) Cow's urine.  E. गो, and द्रव what runs from. गो + द्रु-अच् ।
गोधन: गोधन n. (-नं) A herd of Cows, a multitude or number of cattle, especi-ally if considered as property. 	 m. (-नः) A large headed arrow. E. गो a cow, and धन wealth. गवां धनं समूहः । गोसमूहे ।
गोधा: गोधा f. (-धा) 	 1. A leathern fence worn by archers on the left arm, to prevent its being injured by the bowstring. 	 2. An iguana, either the Gosap or the alligator.  E. गुध् to surround, affixes घञ् and टाप्; see गोधिक. गुध्यते वेष्ट्यते बाहुरनया करणे घञ् ।
गोधापदिका: गोधापदिका f. (-का) Cissus pedata,  E. कन् added to the next.

गोधि: गोधि m. (-धिः) 	 1. The forehead. 	 2. The Gangetic alligator. 	 3. An igua-na.  E. गो the eye or water, and धा to possess, with आधारे इन् aff.
गोधिका: गोधिका f. (-का) 	 1. The Gangetic alligator. 	 2. The iguana.  E. कन् with the fem form added to गोधा.

गोधूम: गोधूम m. (-मः) Wheat: see the next.  E. गुध्-वा° उम ।
गोधूम m. (-मः) 	 1. Wheat. 	 2. The orange. 	 3. The name of a drug.  E. गुध् to surround, and ऊम Unadi aff.
गोधूमचूर्ण: गोधूमचूर्ण n. (-र्णं) Wheat flour.  E. गोधूम, and चूर्ण powder. षष्ठीतत्पुरुषः ।
गोधूमसम्भव: गोधूमसम्भव n. (-वं) Sour paste.  E. गोधूम, and सम्भव produced. सम् + भू-अपादाने अप् गोधूमः सम्भवोऽस्य ।
गोधूलि: गोधूलि f. (-लिः) A period of the day, in the hot season when the sun is half risen; in the cold and dewy seasons, when the sun is full but mild; and in the three other seasons, sunset.  E. गो, and धूलि dust.
गोधेनु: गोधेनु (-नुः) A milch cow.  E. गो a cow, and धेनु the same. सवत्सायां गवि ।
गोधेर: गोधेर mfn. (-रा-रं) A guardian, a protector, a preserver.  E. गुध् एरच् ।
गोनन्दी: गोनन्दी f. (-न्दी) The female of the Sarasa or Indian crane.  E. गो water, नदि to be happy, अच् and ङीष् affs. गवि जले नन्दति । नन्द-अच् ङीष् ।
गोनर्द: गोनर्द m. (-र्दः) The Sarasa or Indian crane. 	 n. (-र्दं) A fragrant grass, (Cyperus rotundus.)  E. गो water, नर्द् to sound, affix अच्.
गोनर्दीय: गोनर्द्दीय m. (-यः) A name of the saint PATANJALI, the founder of Yoga philosophy.  E. गो heaven, नर्द्दीय to be sounded or celebrated.
गोनर्द्दीय: गोनर्द्दीय m. (-यः) A name of the saint PATANJALI, the founder of Yoga philosophy.  E. गो heaven, नर्द्दीय to be sounded or celebrated.
गोनस: गोनस m. (-सः) 	 1. A large kind of snake, by some considered to be the same with the Boa or Bor. 	 2. A kind of gem.  E. गो a cow, and नस a nose, cow-nosed; also गोनास.
गोनाथ: गोनाथ m. (-थः) 	 1. A bull. 	 2. A herdsman.  E. गो, and नाथ master.
गोनास: गोनास mf. (-सः-सा) A snake: see गोनस.  E. गोरिव नासा अस्य वा नसादेशः ।
गोनिष्यन्द: गोनिष्यन्द n. (-ङ्गं) Cow's urine.  E. गो, and निष्यन्द what oozes.  E. गो + निष्यन्द-अच् ।

E. गो the earth &c. and प what preserves; also in some sense गुप् to hide, to protect, &c. affix क, fem. affix टाप् or ङीष्, गां भूमिं वा पाति रक्षति पा-क ।

गोपकन्या: गोपकन्या f. (-न्या) 	 1. The daughter of a cowhered. 	 2. A nymph of Brin-daban. 	 3. A medicinal plant.  E. गोप, and कन्या a daughter.

गोपति: गोपति m. (-तिः) 	 1. A name of SIVA. 	 2. Of INDRA. 	 3. The sun. 	 4. A king. 5. A bull.  E. गो the earth, &c. पति lord or master.

गोपदल: गोपदल m. (-लः) The areca tree.  E. गोप preserving, and दल a leaf.

गोपभद्रिका: गोपभद्रिका f. (-का) The name of a tree: see गम्भारी.  E. गोप a preserver. and भद्र auspicious, and संज्ञायां कन् and टाप् affs.
गोपरस: गोपरस m. (-सः) Gum myrrh.  E. गोप secret, and रस juice exuding in a manner or place unknown.  E. गां जलं पिवति पा-क गोपः रसोऽस्य ।
गोपवल्ली: गोपवल्ली f. (-ल्ली) 	 1. A creeping plant, (Echites frutescens:) see श्यामलता 2. Another plant, (Asclepias pseudosara.)  E. गोप a cowherd, and वल्ली a pedicle, being used in medicines for cattle.
गोपाटविक: गोपाटविक m. (-कः) A cowherd.  E. गो, and पाटविक clever.

गोपायक: गोपायक mfn. (-कः-की-कं) A preserver, a cherisher, one who guards or protects.  E. गुप् to preserve, आय + ण्वुल् aff.
गोपायित: गोपायित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Preserved, protected, cherished.  E. गुप् to pro-tect, affix आय-कर्मणि वाच्ये क्त.

गोपालक: गोपालक m. (-कः) 	 1. SIVA. 	 2. KRISHNA. 	 3. A cow keeper or protector. E. गो a cow or the earth, पाल् to cherish, and ण्वुल् aff.
गोपालिका: गोपालिका f. (-का) 	 1. A kind of worm. 	 2. A female cowherd: see गोपालक.

गोपिन्: गोपिन् mfn. (-पी-पिनी-पि) A protector, one who preserves or protects. 	 f. (-नी) 	 1. A creeping plant, (Echites frutescens.) 	 2. Acowherd's wife.  E. गुप् to preserve, णिनि and ङीप् affs.
गोपिका: गोपिका f. (-का) A female cowherd, &c.: see गोपक.
गोपिल: गोपिल mfn. (-लः-ला-लं) One who preserves or protects.  E. गुप, and इलच् unadi aff.
गोपीचन्दन: गोपीचन्दन n. (-नं) A species of white clay, said to be brought from Dwaraka and used by the worshippers of VISHNU to smear their faces with.  E. गोपी, and चन्दन Sandal.
गोपीथ: गोपीथ m. (-थः) preserving, protecting. 	 n. (-थ) A holy place, a place of pilgrimage.  E. गोप preserving, and थक Unadi affix, deriv. irr.
गोपुच्छ: गोपुच्छ m. (-च्छः) 	 1. A cowtail. 	 2. A sort of necklace, one of four or thirty-four strings. 	 3. A sort of monkey.  E. गो a cow, and पुच्छ a tail, resembling or possessing a cow's tail. गोः पुच्छ इव पुच्छो यस्य ।
गोपुटी: गोपुटी f. (-टी) Large cardamoms.  E. गोरिव पुट मस्याः स्थू लैलायाम् ।
गोपुटिक: गोपुटिक n. (-कं) A temple or edifice consecrated to SIVA'S bull.  E. गो a cow, and पुट् to enclose, affix इकन्.
गोपुर: गोपुर n. (-रं) 	 1. A town gate. 	 2. A gate in general. 	 3. The ornamented gateway of a temple. 	 4. A kind of grass, (Cyperus rotundus.) E. पर अग्रगमने क गवां पुरं गवा जलेन पूर्य्यते पॄ घञर्थे क वा ।
गोपुरीष: गोपुरीष n. (-षं) Cow-dung.  E. गो, and पुरीष dung.
गोपेन्द्र: गोपेन्द्र m. (-न्द्रः) A name of KRISHNA or VISHNU.  E. गोप a cowherd, and इन्द्र lord or chief.
गोपेश: गोपेश m. (-शः) 	 1. A name of SAKYA MUNI, a Buddha. 	 2. A name of KRISHNA. 	 3. A chief herdsman, the keeper or owner of kine. 	 4. A name of NANDA.  E. गोप cowherd, and ईश lord.
गोप्तृ: गोप्तृ mfn. (-प्ता-प्त्री-प्तृ) A preserver, A protector, one who defends or cherishes.  E. गुप् to preserve, &c. affix तृच्.
गोप्य: गोप्य mfn. (-प्यः-प्या-प्यं) 	 1. To be cherished or preserved. 	 2. To be kept secret or hidden. 	 3. To be kept, to be taken care of. 	 m. (-प्यः) 1. A slave. 	 2. The son of a female slave.  E. गुप् to preserve, &c. कर्मणि यत् aff.
गोप्यक: गोप्यक m. (-कः) A servant or slave.  E. कन् added to the proceding.
गोप्याधि: गोप्याधि f. (-धिः) A pledge, that is not be used, but to be carefully preserved.  E. गोप्य to be preserved, and आधि a pledge.
गोप्रकाण्ड: गोप्रकाण्ड n. (-ण्डं) An excellent cow.  E. गो a cow, and प्रकाण्ड excellent; the compound is always neuter. प्रशस्तो गौ नित्यसमासः परनिपातः ।
गोप्रचार: गोप्रचार m. (-रः) Pasturage ground.  E. गो, and प्रचार going. प्रचरति अस्मिन् प्र + चर अधारे घञ् ।
गोबध: गोबध m. (-धः) Killing a cow.  E. गो, and बध killing.
गोबाल: गोबाल m. (-लः) The hair of a cow.  E. गो, and बाल hair. षष्ठीतत्पुरुषः ।
गोभण्डीर: गोभण्डीर m. (-रः) A water fowl.  E. गो water, भटि to sound affix ईरन्.

गोमण्डल: गोमण्डल n. (-लं) The earth, the globe. गोसमूहे.  E. गो, and मण्डल sphere. षष्ठीतत्पुरुषः ।
गोमत्: गोमत् mfn. (-मान्-मती-मत्) Possessing herds, rich in cattle. 	 f. (-मती) The name of a river, the Goomti, in the province of Oude. 	 2. A prayer or formula of the Vedas to be repeated during expiation for killing a cow.  E. गो a cow or water, and मतुप् aff. गौरस्ति अस्य ।
गोमतल्लिका: गोमतल्लिका f. (-का) A tractable and good cow.  E. गो a cow, मतल्लिका excellent.
गोमध्यमध्य: गोमध्यमध्य mfn. (-ध्यः-ध्या-ध्यं) Slender in the waist.  E. गो a cow &c. मध्य middle: repeated.
गोमन्त: गोमन्त m. (-न्तः) 	 1. The name of a mountain. 	 2. An owner of cattle. 3. A herd of cattle.  E. गो the earth, मन् to mind, झ aff.
गोमय: गोमय mn. (-यः-यं) 	 1. Cowdung. 	 2. The property or nature of a cow. E. गो a cow, and मयट् affix of relation or comprehension.
गोमयच्छत्र: गोमयच्छत्र n. (-त्रं) A mushroom, a fungus.  E. गोमय cowdung, and छत्र a Chatta or parasol.
गोमयच्छत्रिका: गोमयच्छत्रिका f. (-का) A kind of fungus or mushroom.  E. कन् and the fem. form added to the preceding.
गोमयप्रिय: गोमयप्रिय n. (-यं) A sort of grass, (Andropogon schœnanthus.) भूतृणे, शिलीन्ध्रे  E. गोमय cow-dung, and प्रिय favourable to.
गोमयोत्था: गोमयोत्था f. (-त्था) A kind of beetle found in cowdung.  E. गोमय cow-dung, and उत्थ what rises or is generated. उद् + स्था-क टाप् ।
गोमयोद्भव: गोमयोद्भव m. (-वः) Cassia fistula.  E. गोमय, and उद्भव born, produced, re-quiring manure. गोमयादुद्भवति उद् + भू अच् ।
गोमायु: गोमायु m. (-युः) 	 1. A jackall. 	 2. A kind of Gandharba or celestial mu-sician. 	 3. The bile or bilious humor of the cow.  E. गो sound, &c. मा to measure, and उण् Unadi affix, य inserted, or गो a cow, and मायु bile. गां विकृतां वाचं मिनाति ।
गोमिथुन: गोमिथुन n. (-नं) A pair of cattle.  E. गो, and मिथुन a couple.
गोमिन्: गोमिन् mfn. (-मी-मिनी-मि) Rich in herds, &c. 	 m. (-मी) 	 1. The owner of cattle. 	 2. A jackal. 	 3. A worshipper. 	 4. An attendant on a Buddha.  E. गो a cow, &c. मिनि aff. गौरस्ति अस्य मिनि ।
गोमिल: गोमिल m. (-लः) Name of a Muni.
गोमीन: गोमीन m. (-नः) A sort of fish, the bull-fish.  E. गो, and मीन a fish.
गोमुख: गोमुख n. (-खं) 	 1. A house build unevenly or crookedly, viz. with angles, projections, &c. 	 2. A kind of musical instrument, (a sort of horn or trumpet) 	 3. Spreading unguents, plastering, smear-ing. 	 4. A hole in a wall made by thieves, &c. a breach. 	 m. (-खः) 1. A shark. 	 2. A kind of Yaksha; according to the Jainas, a demigod subservient to their deified saints. 	 nf. (-खं-खी) A cloth-bag, containing a rosary into which the hand is thrust to count the beads. 	 f. (-खी) The chasm in the Himalaya mountains through which the Ganges flows, erroneously conceived by the Hindus to be of the shape of a cow's mouth. 	 2. A river in Bengal.  E. गो a cow, and मुख face, having the face of a cow, &c. गोमुखमिव मुखमस्य ।
गोमूढ: गोमूढ mfn. (-ढः-ढा-ढं) Stupid as an ox.  E. गो, and मूढ foolish.
गोमूत्र: गोमूत्र n. (-त्रं) Cow's urine.  E. गो, and मूत्र urine. षष्ठीतत्पुरुषः ।
गोमूत्रिका: गोमूत्रिका f. (-का) 	 1. A kind of grass, described as growing in corn fields, of a reddish colour, and eaten by cattle, commonly Tam-bada (ताम्बड) 	 2. A verse the second half of which repeats nearly all the syllables of the first. 	 3. A form of calculation.  E. गो, मूत्र urine, ठन् affix; operating on cows as a diuretic. गोर्मूत्रस्येव गतिरस्ति अत्र ।
गोमेद: गोमेद m. (-दः) A yellow gem: see the next.
गोमेदक: गोमेदक mn. (-कः-कं) 	 1. A gem or precious stone brought from the Himalaya and Indus, described as of four sorts, white, pale yellow, red, and dark blue, perhaps varieties of a gate. 2. A kind of poison: see काकोल. 	 6. Smearing the body with un-guents.  E. गो the eye, मिद् to anoint, &c. affix अच् and कन्.
गोमेदसन्निभ: गोमेदसन्निभ m. (-भः) Chalcedony or opal.  E. गोमेद, and सन्निभ what resem-bles.
गोमेध: गोमेध m. (-धः) The offering or sacrifice of a cow.  E. गो a cow, and मेध sacrifice. मेध-वधे आधारे घञ् । षष्ठीतत्पुरुषः ।
गोयान: गोयान n. (-नं) 	 1. A cart. 	 2. A carriage drawn by oxen.  E. गो, and यान a vehicle.
गोयुग: गोयुग n. (-गं) A yoke of oxen.  E. गो, and युग a pair.
गोरक्ष: गोरक्ष mfn. (-क्षः-क्षा-क्षं) A cow keeper, the cherisher or preserver of kine. m. (-क्षः) 	 1. The orange. 	 2. Keeping or tending cattle. 	 3. A name of SIVA. 	 f. (-क्षी) A small shrub.  E. गो a cow, and रक्ष who preserves.
गोरक्षक: गोरक्षक m. (-कः) A cow keeper, one who tends cattle.  E. कन् added to the last.
गोरक्षजम्बू: गोरक्षजम्बू f. (-म्बूः) 	 1. Wheat. 	 2. A plant, (Hedysarum lagopodioides;) also गाङ्गेरुकी. 	 3. The fruit of the jujube.  E. गोरक्ष, and जम्बू a rose-apple.
गोरक्षण: गोरक्षण n. (णं) Tending or taking charge of cattle  E. गो, and रक्षण protecting.
गोरक्षतण्डुला: गोरक्षतण्डुला f. (-ला) A plant, (Hedysarum lagopodioides.)  E. गोरक्ष cow-preserving, and तण्डुल grain, used in medicines for cattle.
गोरक्ष्य: गोरक्ष्य n. (-क्ष्यं) Tending cattle.  E. गो, and रक्ष्य to be preserved.
गोरङ्कु: गोरङ्कु m. (-ङ्कुः) 	 1. A water-fowl. 	 2. A prisoner, a person or animal confined. 	 3. A naked man, a mendicant, &c. wandering about without clothes.  E. गो water, sky, &c. रङ्कु a kind of deer: as it were, the water deer, &c. गवा वाचा रङ्कुरिव ।
गोरण: गोरण n. (-णं) Effort, exertion.  E. गुर् to make effort, affix ल्युट्; also गुरण.
गोरस: गोरस mn. (-सः-सं) 	 1. Milk. 	 2. Curdled or coagulated milk. 	 3. Butter-milk.  E. गो a cow, and रस juice.
गोरसज: गोरसज n. (-जं) 	 1. Butter-milk. 	 2. Curds,  E. गोरस, and ज produced.
गोराज: गोराज m. (-जः) A bull.  E. गो a cow, and राजन् a king, टच् aff.
गोराटी: गोराटी f. (-टी) A small bird, (Turdus salica.  E. गो speech, रट् to utter, affix अच्, feminine affix ङीष्.
गोरुत: गोरुत n. (-तं) A measure of distance equal to two Crosa or Cos: see गव्यूतिः ।
गोरोच: गोरोच n. (-चं) Yellow orpiment.  E. गो, and रोच what shines. गवा किरणेन रोचते रोच-अच् ।
गोरोचना: गोरोचना f. (-ना) A bright yellow pigment prepared from the urine of a cow, or vomited in the shape of scibulæ by the animal; or accor-ding to some, found in the head of a cow; it is employed in paint-ing and dying, and is of especial virtue in marking the foreheads of the Hindus with the Tilaka or sectarial mark; it is also used in medicine as a sedative, tonic, and anthelmintic remedy, &c.  E. गो a cow, रुचि to shine, affix ल्युट्. गोभ्यो जाता रोचना हरिद्रा ।
गोर्द: गोर्द्द n. (-र्द्दं) The brain.  E. गुर् to endeavor, and दन् affix; also गोद.
गोर्द्द: गोर्द्द n. (-र्द्दं) The brain.  E. गुर् to endeavor, and दन् affix; also गोद.
गोल: गोल mn. (-लः-लं) A circle, a ball, any thing round or globular. 	 m. (-लः) 1. A widow's bastard. 	 2. Myrrh. 	 3. A tree, (Vangueria spinosa.) 4. A globe, celestial or terrestrial. 	 5. Conjunction of planets, or the presence of several in one sign. 	 f. (-ला) 	 1. A globe. a sphere, a Mandala. 	 2. A wooden ball with which children play. 	 3. A woman's female friend. 	 4. The Godavari river. 	 5. A large water jar. 	 6. Ink. 7. Red arsenic. 	 8. A name of the goddess DURGA.  E. गो heaven, water, &c. and ल what gets or receives; again, गुड् to be round, &c. affix अच् and ड changed to ल. डलयोरैक्यात् ।
गोलक: गोलक m. (-कः) 	 1. A wooden ball for playing with, or any thing globu-lar, a sphere, a globe, &c. 	 2. A widow's bastard. 	 3. A water jar. 4. Gum myrrh, 5. Pease. 	 n. (-कं) The heaven of KRISHNA.  E. कन् added to the preceding. गुड-ण्वुल् डस्य लः ।
गोलाङ्गूल: गोलाङ्गूल m. (-लः) A kind of monkey, described as of a black colour, and having a tail like a cow.  E. गो a cow, and लाङ्गूल a tail.
गोलाध्याय: गोलाध्याय m. (-यः) The division of mathematical science which treats of the spheres, spherics.  E. गोल the globe, and अध्याय chapter.
गोलास: गोलास m. (-सः) A mushroom, a kind of fungus springing from cowdung.
गोलिह: गोलिह m. (-हः) A plant, commonly Ghantaparuli.  E. गो a cow, and लिह to lick, affix क; upon which kine graze. गोभिर्लिह्यते लिह-घञर्थे क ।
गोलीढ: गोलीढ m. (-ढः) A plant: see the preceding.  E. गो, and लिह as above, affix क्त. गोभिर्लिह्यते लिह क्त ।
गोलोक: गोलोक n. (-कं) The heaven of KRISHNA.  E. गो a cow, and लोक world.
गोलोमिका: गोलोमिका f. (-का) A kind of small shrub.  E. गोलोमन् cow's hair, कन् affix, fem. form.
गोलोमी: गोलोमी f. (-मी) 	 1. A kind of bent grass, with white blossoms; also श्वेत-दूर्ब्बा. 	 2. Root of sweet flag. Orris root. 	 4. A whore. a harlot. 	 5. A small shrub.  E. गो the earth, &c. and लोमन् hair, the hair of the earth.
गोवन्दनी: गोवन्दनी f. (-नी) A plant bearing a fragrant seed: see प्रियङ्गु  E. गो the earth, and वन्दनी praising.
गोवर्द्धन: गोवर्द्धन m. (-नः) A celebrated hill in Brindaban or the country about Mathura: it was upheld by KRISHNA upon one finger, to shelter the cowherds from a storm excited by INDRA, as a test of the for-mer's divinity.  E. गो a cow, and वर्द्धन increasing; pasturing cattle.
गोवर्द्धनधर: गोवर्द्धनधर m. (-रः) A name of KRISHNA or VISHNU.  E. गोवर्द्धन Gober-dhana, and धर who upholds: see the preceding.
गोवशा: गोवशा f. (-शा) A barren cow.  E. गो a cow, and वशा barren.
गोविन्द: गोविन्द m. (-न्दः) 	 1. One of the most usual appellations of KRISHNA or VISHNU in that form. 	 2. A name of VRIHASPATI, regent of JUPITER. 	 3. A cow-keeper, one who protects, cherishes or owns cattle.  E. गो language, here the language of the Vedas especially, and विन्द who knows, from विद् to know, with श affix; also गो heaven, a cow, विद् to obtain, by whom heaven is obtained, or who obtains felicity by protecting kine. गां वेदमयीं वाणीं, भुवं धेनुं स्वर्गं वा विन्दति ।
गोविष्: गोविष् f. (-विट्) Cow-dung.  E. गो a cow, and विष् ordure; also गोविष्ठा.
गोवृन्द: गोवृन्द n. (-न्दं) 	 1. Property in cattle, possession of flocks and herds. 	 2. A herd, a drove of cattle.  E. गो a cow, and वृन्द a heap, a multitude.
गोवृन्दारक: गोवृन्दारक m. (-कः) A capital cow.  E. गो a cow, and वृन्दारक affix of pre-eminence.
गोवृष: गोवृष m. (-षः) A bull. N. गो a cow, and वृष best, pre-eminent.
गोव्रज: गोव्रज m. (-जः) A station for cattle.  E. गो and व्रज a pen. a fold.
गोशकृत्: गोशकृत् n. (-कृत्) Cow. dung.  E. गो a cow, and शकृत् ordure.
गोशाल: गोशाल mfn. sub. (-लः-ला-लं) A cow-house. adj. Born in a cow-house. E. गो a cow, and शाला a hall.
गोशीर्ष: गोशीर्ष n. (-र्षं) 	 1. A kind of Sandal, described as of the colour of brass, and of great fragrance. 	 2. The head of a cow.  E. गो a cow, and शीर्ष the head.
गोशीर्षक: गोशीर्षक m. (-कः) A plant; also called Drona pushpa.  E. कन् added to गोशीर्ष.
गोशृङ्ग: गोशृङ्ग m. (-ङ्गः) A tree; also Berbera. 	 n. (-ङ्गं) The horn of a cow.  E. गो, and शृङ्ग a horn.
गोष्ठ: गोष्ठ r. 1st cl. (गोष्ठते) To assemble, to collect, to heap together.

गोष्ठ mn. (-ष्ठः-ष्ठं) 	 1. A cowpen, a fold for cattle, any place where animals are kept. 	 2. A station of cow-herds. 	 f. (-ष्ठी) 	 1. An assembly, a meet-ing. 	 2. Conversation, discourse, dialogue, dispute. 	 3. Family con-nexions, but especially the dependent or junior branches. 	 4. A dramatic composition in one act.  E. गो a cow, and ष्ठ from स्था to stay, with क affix; here meaning the place of abiding, or गोष्ठ to assemble, affix अच्.
गोष्ठवेदिका: गोष्ठवेदिका f. (-का) A mound or altar in a cowpen.  E. गोष्ठ, and वेदिका a mound.
गोष्ठश्व: गोष्ठश्व mfn. (-श्वः-श्वं-श्व) Malignant, censorious, envious: especially appli-ed to a person who stays at home, and slanders his neighbours. E. गोष्ठ a cowpen, in the first case used for abode in general, and श्वि to increase, affix ड, who magnifies himself in his own house. 	 m. (-श्वः) A horse in a cowpen.  E. गोष्ठ, and अश्व a horse, the form is irregular.
गोष्ठाष्टमी: गोष्ठाष्टमी f. (-मी) A particular holiday: see गोपाष्टमी.
गोष्ठीपति: गोष्ठीपति m. (-तिः) 	 1. The chief person in an assembly, a president. 	 2. The master of a family.  E. गोष्ठी, and पति master.
गोष्पद: गोष्पद n. (-दं) 	 1. A spot frequented by kine. 	 2. A measure, as much as a cow's footstep will hold. 	 3. The mark or impression of a cow's foot. 	 4. A cow's foot or hoof.  E. गो a cow, and पद for पाद a foot.
गोस: गोस m. (-सः) 	 1. Gum myrrh. 	 2. The last watch of the night, early morning or day-break.  E. गो water, dew, and सो to destroy, to absorb; affix ड.
गोसंख्य: गोसंख्य m. (-ख्यः) A herdsman, a cowherd.  E. गो a cow, and सम् pre-fixed to ख्या to count, affix ड.
गोसगृह: गोसगृह n. (-हं) The inner part of a house, an inner or sleeping room, a bed-chamber.
गोसङ्ग: गोसङ्ग m. (-ङ्गः) Dawn, day-break.  E. गो a cow, and सङ्ग meeting, junc-tion; the herd assembling at that time.
गोसदृक्ष: गोसदृक्ष m. (-क्षः) The Gayal, (Bos gavæus.)  E. गो a cow, and सदृक्ष like, from सदृश with स aff. गोः सदृक्षः । गोतुल्ये, गवये ।
गोसन्दाय: गोसन्दाय m. (-यः) Ono who gives a cow.  E. गो a cow, दा to give, with सम् prefixed, युक् augment, affix अच्.
गोसम्भव: गोसम्भव mfn. (-वः-वा-वं) Produced from or by a cow.  E. गो, and सम्भव born.
गोसर्ग: गोसर्ग m. (-र्गः) Dawn, day-break.  E. गो a cow, and सर्ग going forth, the cattle then going forth to pasture.
गोसव: गोसव m. (-वः) The sacrifice of a cow, one of the grand sacrifices of the Hindus in former times, and not permitted in the present or Kali yuga age: see गोमेध.  E. गो a cow, and सब sacrifice.
गोशशस: गोशशस m. (-शः) Myrrh: गवि जले शशति शश-वा असच् सप्तमी तत्पुरुषः । वोलि ।
गोस्तन: गोस्तन m. (-नः) 	 1. The udder of a cow. 	 2. A garland consisting of four or of thirty-four strings. 	 3. A cluster of blossoms, a nosegay, &c. 	 f. (-ना or -नी) A grape.  E. गो a cow, and स्तन a breast, full or clustering like the udder of a cow. गोः स्तन इव गुच्छो यस्य ।
गोस्थान: गोस्थान n. (-नं) A cowpen, a station for cattle.  E. गो a cow, and स्थान a place; also with कन् added गोस्थानक.
गोस्वामिन्: गोस्वामिन् m. (-मी) 	 1. The master or possessor of herds. 	 2. A holy man, a religious personage and teacher; in common language, a Gossawami.  E. गो kine, or an organ of sense, and स्वामिन् a lord or master. गवां स्वामिनि ।
गोहत्या: गोहत्या f. (-त्या) Killing a cow.  E. गो, and हत्या murder. गोहनने.
गोहन्न: गोहन्न n. (-न्नं) Cow-dung  E. गो, and हन्न ordure.
गोहरीतकी: गोहरीतकी f. (-की) Vilwa or Bel, (Ægle marmelos.) गोः हरितकीव हित-कारित्वात् ।
गोहित: गोहित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 	 1. Proper or fit for cattle. 	 2. Cherishing or pro-tecting kine. 	 m. (-तः) 	 1. A creeping plant; also घोषा 2. The Bel tree.  E. गो a cow, and हित suitable, &c. गवां हितं यस्मात् ।
गोहिर: गोहिर n. (-रं) The heel.  E. गुह् to cover, इरच् aff.
गोह्य: गोह्य mfn. (-ह्यः-ह्या-ह्यं) 	 1. To be covered or concealed. 	 2. To be kept secret.  E. गुह to cover, ण्यत् aff.
गौञ्जिक: गौञ्जिक m. (-कः) A goldsmith.  E. गुञ्जा the small weight especially used by goldsmiths, and ठक् aff. गुञ्जा तुलमानभेदः तद्ग्रहणं शीलमस्य । ठक् ।
गौड: गौड m. (-डः) The district of Gaur, the central part of Bengal, extend-ing from Banga to Bhubaneshwar in Orrissa: the ruins of its capital, called by the same name, are still in existance. 	 m. plu. (-डाः) The inhabitants of Gaur. 	 f. (-डी) 	 1. Rum or spirit distilled from Gur or molasses. 	 2. One of the Raginis. 	 3. A style of poetry, the bold and spirited style,  E. गुड to surround, or गुड raw sugar, and अण् affix, fem. affix ङीष्.
गौडिक: गौडिक mfn. (-कः-की-कं) Of or relating to Gur or molasses. 	 n. (-कं) Rum.  E. गुड as above, affix of relation ठक्.
गौण: गौण mfn. (-णः-णी-णं) 	 1. Having qualities or attributes. 	 2. Relating to multiplication or enumeration. 	 3. Secondary, subordinate. 	 4. Secondery as applied to the month, reckoned from full-moon to full-moon.  E. गुण, and अण् aff. गुणमधिकृत्य प्रवृत्ता गौणी ततः आगतः अण् ।
गौणिक: गौणिक mfn. (-कः-की-कं) Having qualities, relating to or connected with them.  E. गुण, and ठक् aff. गुणे रूपादौ साधुः ।
गौतम: गौतम m. (-मः) 	 1. The name of a saint or sage and founder of the Nyaya philosophy. 	 2. A legislator of the same name. 	 3. A name of SAKYA Muni, the original Buddha or founder of the Bauddha sect. 	 4. A name of the first pupil of the last Jaina. 	 5. Name of a tribe or family of Brahmans descended from GOTAMA. 	 6. A poison, one of the fixed kinds, or mineral, vegetable, &c. 	 f. (-मी) 	 1. A name of DURGA. 	 2. A female Rakshasa or goblin. 	 3. A yellow dye: see गोरोचना 4. The Godavari river.  E. गोतम a sage, and अण् patro-nomic affix, &c.
गौधार: गौधार m. (-रः) An iguana.  E. गोधा an alligator, and आरक् affix of des-cent; considered as the offspring of the alligator, on account of its smaller size, and similar shape; also गौधेय and गौधेर.
गौधेय: गौधेय m. (-यः) An iguana.  E. गोधा, and ढक् affix: see the last.
गौधेर: गौधेर m. (-रः) An iguana.  E. गोधा, and ढक् affix; see गौधारः
गौपुच्छिक: गौपुच्छिक mfn. (-कः-की-कं) Of or belonging to a cow's tail, bought for a cow's tail, &c.  E. गो, and पुच्छ a tail, affix ठञ्. गोपुच्छेन क्रीतम् ।
गौर: गौर mfn. (-रः-रा-री-रं) 	 1. White. 	 2. Yellow. 	 3. Pale red: (or it may be used as a noun substantive mas. to imply either of these colours.) 4. Clean, cleansed, pure. 	 m. (-रः) 	 1. white mustard. 	 2. The moon. 3. A tree, (Grislea tomentosa:) see धवः 4. A name of CHAITANA. 	 n. (-रं) 	 1. The filament of a lotus. 	 2. Gold. 	 3. Saffron f. (-रा-री) 	 1. A. name of the goddess PARVATI. (-री) 	 2. A young girl, eight years old. 	 3. Any young girl prior to menstruation, a maid, a virgin. 	 4. The name of a river. 	 5. The wife of the deity VARUNA. 	 6. The earth. 	 7. Turmeric. 	 8. A yellow dye called Gorochana. 	 9. A plant: see रोचनी. 	 10. A plant bearing a fragrant seed: see प्रियङ्गु. 	 11. One of the female energies or Saktis of the Bauddhas. 	 12. A white kind of Durva or bent grass. 	 13. Arabian jasmin. 	 14. Sacred basil or Tulasi. 	 15. One of the Raginis.  E. गुड to sound. and रन् Unadi affix, the deriv. is irregular; also गुरी to endeavour, धञ् affix, and derivative irr.; upon whom or what the mind exerts itself; again, गौर white, pure, &c. affix ङीष्, that which is white or brilliant, &c. which applies to the virgin, &c.
गौरचन्द्र: गौरचन्द्र m. (-न्द्रः) A name of the saint CHAITANYA.
गौरव: गौरव n. (-वं) 	 1. Reputation, respectability, venerableness or weight. 2. Physical weight, heaviness.  E. गुरु heavy, respectable, &c. and अण् affix, implying condition of being. गुरोर्भावः कर्म वा ।
गौरवित: गौरवित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Venerable, respectable.  E. गौरव, and इतच् aff.
गौरवेरित: गौरवेरित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Praised, famed, celebrated.  E. गौरव, fame, and ईरित declared.
गौरशाक: गौरशाक m. (-कः) A species of bassia; also मधुक.  E. गौर pale white, and शाक a potherb. गौरः शाकः अस्य मधुकभेदे ।
गौरसर्षप: गौरसर्षप m. (-पः) 	 1. White mustard. 	 2. The white mustard seed con-sidered as a measure of weight.  E. गौर white, and सर्षप mustard, also गौर.
गौराङ्ग: गौराङ्ग m. (-ङ्गः) A name of CHAITANA.  E. गौर pale, and अङ्ग body.
गौरार्द्रक: गौरार्द्रक m. (-कः) A kind of poison.  E. गौर white, and आर्द्रक ginger.
गौरास्य: गौरास्य m. (-स्यः) A black monkey with a white face.  E. गौर, and आस्य face.
गौरिका: गौरिका f. (-का) A virgin, a young girl, one eight years old, or in whom menstruation has not commenced.  E. गौरी as above, and ठन् aff.
गौरिल: गौरिल m. (-लः) 	 1. White mustard. 	 2. Iron or steel filings or dust. E. गौर pale white, and इलच् aff. गौरवर्णोऽस्ति अस्य वा इलच् । श्वेतसर्षपे । लौहचूर्णे ।
गौरीज: गौरीज m. (-जः) KARTIKEYA or GANESA. 	 n. (-जं) Talc.  E. गौरी, and ज born.
गौरीपट्ट: गौरीपट्ट m. (-ट्टः) The horizontal plate of the Linga, typical of the female organ.  E. गौरी, and पट्ट a layer. गौर्य्याः पट्टमिव स्थानम् ।
गौरीपति: गौरीपति m. (-तिः) A name of SIVA.  E. गौरी, and पति husband.
गौरीपुत्त्र: गौरीपुत्त्र m. (-त्त्रः) A name of the deity KARTIKEYA.  E. गौरी the goddess, and पुत्त्र a son, the son of GAURI.
गौरीललित: गौरीललित n. (-तं) Yellow orpiment.  E. गौरी the goddess, or a young girl, and ललित loved, liked; this being used as a dye to stain the clo-thes of women, &c.
गौरुतल्पिक: गौरुतल्पिक m. (-कः) A violator of the bed of a Guru.  E. गुरु, तल्प a bed, and ठक् aff.
गौलक्षणिक: गौलक्षणिक m. (-कः) One who distinguishes the good marks of a cow. E. गो, लक्षण a mark, ठक् aff.
गौशतिक: गौशतिक m. (-कः) One possessing a hundred cows.  E. गौ, शत a hundred, and ठञ् aff.
गौष्ठीन: गौष्ठीन n. (-नं) The site of an old and abandoned cowpen.  E. गोष्ठ a cow-pen, and खञ् aff. पूर्वं भूतं गोष्ठं खञ् । भूतपूर्वगोष्ठे ।
गौसहस्रिक: गौसहस्रिक m. (-कः) One who has a thousand cows.  E. गो, सहस्र a thous-and, ठञ् aff. गोसहस्रमस्ति अस्य गौशतिकवत् ठञ् । गोसहस्रस्वामिनि ।
ग्रथ: ग्रथ r. 1st cl. (इ) ग्रथि (ग्रन्थते) 1. To be crooked. 	 2. To be crooked meta-phorically, to be wicked. 	 3. To curve, to bend or make crooked. 	 4. to string together, to arrange. r. 10th cl. (ग्रथयति) To bind or tie.
ग्रथित: ग्रथित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 	 1. Strung, tied together or in order. 	 2. Collected. 3. Arranged, classed. 	 4. Overcome. 	 5. Hurt, injured.  E. ग्रथि to bind, affix क्त.
ग्रन्थ: ग्रन्थ r. 1st, 9th and 10th cls. (ग्रन्थति, ग्रथ्नाति ग्रन्थयति) To string, to tie to-gether, to connect or arrange in a regular series. With उद् pre-fixed, To untie, to loosen.

ग्रन्थ m. (-न्थः) 	 1. Stringing or tying together, (literally or metaphori-cally.) 	 2. Wealth, property. 	 3. A book or composition in prose or verse. 	 4. A metre or measure of thirty two syllables.  E. ग्रन्थ to dis-pose or arrange, affix भावे कर्मणि वा घञ् ।
ग्रन्थकर्तृ: ग्रन्थकर्त्तृ m. (-र्त्ता) An author.  E. ग्रन्थ, and कर्त्तृ maker.
ग्रन्थकर्त्तृ: ग्रन्थकर्त्तृ m. (-र्त्ता) An author.  E. ग्रन्थ, and कर्त्तृ maker.
ग्रन्थकार: ग्रन्थकार m. (-रः) An author.  E. ग्रन्थ, and कार who makes. ग्रन्थं करोति अण् उप० स० ।
ग्रन्थकुटी: ग्रन्थकुटी f. (-टी) An office a study, a library.  E. ग्रन्थ a book, and कुटी a house or room.
ग्रन्थन: ग्रन्थन nf. (-नं-ना) Arranging. stringing, tying or connecting together either as a chaplet or a book.  E. ग्रन्थ to arrange, affix भावे ल्युट् or ग्रन्थ चुरा-युच् ।
ग्रन्थविस्तर: ग्रन्थविस्तर m. (-रः) A voluminous work.  E. ग्रन्थ, and विस्तर extent.
ग्रन्थि: ग्रन्थि m. (-न्थिः) 	 1. The joint or knot of a reed or cane, &c. 	 2. A tie, the knot of a cord, &c. 	 3. A joint or articulation of the body, 4. A plant, commonly Ganthiala: see ग्रन्थिपर्ण. 	 5. Crookedness, dis-tortion. 	 6. A complaint, knotting of the vessels as in varicocele, &c.  E. ग्रन्थ to connect, &c. Unadi affix इन्.
ग्रन्थिक: ग्रन्थिक m. (-कः) 	 1. An astrologer, a fortune teller. 	 2. The youngest of the Pandus. 	 3. A thorny plant: see करीर. 	 n. (-कं) 	 1. The root of long pepper. 	 2. A kind of resin, Bdellium. 	 3. A perfume: see ग्रन्थि-पर्ण.  E. कन् added to the preceding, or ग्रन्थ a book, &c. and ठन् aff.
ग्रन्थित: ग्रन्थित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Strung, tied.  E. ग्रन्थ to tie, affix क्त.
ग्रन्थिदूर्वा: ग्रन्थिदूर्व्वा f. (-र्व्वा) A species of Durva grass.  E. ग्रन्थि, and दूर्व्वा Panicum dactylon.
ग्रन्थिदूर्व्वा: ग्रन्थिदूर्व्वा f. (-र्व्वा) A species of Durva grass.  E. ग्रन्थि, and दूर्व्वा Panicum dactylon.
ग्रन्थिन्: ग्रन्थिन् mfn. (-न्थी-न्थिनी-न्थि) 	 1. Bookish, read, learned. 	 2. Relating or be-longing to a book, &c.  E. ग्रन्थ, and णिनि aff.
ग्रन्थिपर्ण: ग्रन्थिपर्ण m. (-र्णः) A plant, and according to some authorities a perfume commonly called Ganthiala.  E. ग्रन्थ a knot, and पर्ण a leaf.
ग्रन्थिबन्धन: ग्रन्थिबन्धन n. (-नं) 	 1. Tying a knot. 	 2. A ligament. 	 3. Tying together the garments of the bride and bridegroom at the marriage cere-mony.  E. ग्रन्थि, and बन्धन binding.
ग्रन्थिमत्: ग्रन्थिमत् m. (-मान्) A plant, (Heliotropium indicum;) also अस्थिसंहार. E. ग्रन्थि knot, and मतुप् poss. aff.
ग्रन्थिमूल: ग्रन्थिमूल n. (-लं) Garlic.  E. ग्रन्थि a knot, and मूल root.
ग्रन्थिल: ग्रन्थिल mfn. (-लः-ला-लं) Knotted, knotty, &c. 	 m. (-लः) 	 1. A plant, com-monly Bainchi (Flacourtia sapida, Rox.) 	 2. Karir, a thorny plant, capparis:) see करीर. 	 n. (-लं) 	 1. Green or undried ginger. 	 2. Root of long pepper.  E. ग्रन्थि a knot, and लच् aff.
ग्रन्थिवर्हिन्: ग्रन्थिवर्हिन् m. (-र्ही) A plant: see ग्रन्थिपर्ण.  E. ग्रन्थि a knot, वर्ह to cover, and णिनि aff.
ग्रन्थिहर: ग्रन्थिहर m. (-रः) A counsellor, a minister.  E. ग्रन्थि knot, and हर who removes; who unties the knots of business.  E. ग्रन्थिं हरति हर-अच् ।
ग्रन्थीक: ग्रन्थीक n. (-कं) The root of long pepper: see ग्रन्थिक. पिप्पलीमूले ।

ग्रसन: ग्रसन n. (-नं) 	 1. Swallowing, eating. 	 2. Taking, seizing.  E. ग्रस् to take भावे ल्युट् aff.
ग्रसमान: ग्रसमान mfn. (-नः-ना-नं) 	 1. Swallowing, devouring. 	 2. Receiving or listen-ing to any thing eagerly.  E. ग्रस् to eat, शानच् aff.
ग्रसिष्णु: ग्रसिष्णु mfn. (-ष्णुः-ष्णुः-ष्णु) Eating, taking food.  E. ग्रस् to eat, इष्णुच् aff.
ग्रस्त: ग्रस्त mfn. (-स्तः-स्ता-स्तं) 	 1. Inarticulately pronounced, slurred, uttered with the omission of a letter or syllable. 	 2. Eaten. 	 3. Taken, seized. 	 4. Affected by. 	 5. Commenced as an eclipse, eclipsed. E. ग्रस् to eat, affix कर्मणि क्त.
ग्रस्तास्त: ग्रस्तास्त mfn. (-स्तः-स्ता-स्तं) Commenced and ended as an eclipse.  E. ग्रस्त seized. अस्त set.
ग्रह: ग्रह r. 1st, and 10th cls. (ग्रहति-ग्रहयति) r. 9th cl. (उभ) ग्रहू (गृह्णाति गृह्णीते) 1. To take, to seize, to receive or accept. With अनु, prefixed, To favour, to show kindness to. With अव, To oppose. With उत्, To deposit, to trust. With उप, To provide. 	 2. To favour. With नि, 1. To take, to arrest. 	 2. To punish. 	 3. To restrain. With परि, To lay hold of, to seize. With प्रति, 1. To assent to, to receive as a precept or truth. 	 2. To embrace, to enfold, to comprehend or contain. 	 3. To subdue. 	 4. To accept. With वि, To quarrel, to fight. With सम्, To collect, to assemble. क्न्या-उभ-सक-सेट् । आदाने वा चुरा-उभ पक्षे भ्वा-प ।

ग्रह m. (-हः) 	 1. Taking, whether by seizure or acceptance. 	 2. An eclipse or seizure of the sun or moon, by RAHU, &c. 	 3. A planet. 4. The place of a planet in the fixed zodiac. 	 5. A moveable point in the heavens. 	 6. A name of RAHU, or the ascending node. 	 7. An imp, one of a particular class, beginning with PUTANA, sup-posed especially to seize upon young children producing convul-sions. 	 8. Effort in battle. 	 9. Tenacity, perseverance. 	 10. Purpose, design. 	 11. Favor, patronage.  E. ग्रह् to take, &c. affix अच्.
ग्रहकल्लोल: ग्रहकल्लोल m. (-लः) A name of RAHU, the personified ascending node. E. ग्रह a planet, and कल्लोल an enemy.
ग्रहगण: ग्रहगण m. (-णः) The planets taken collectively.  E. ग्रह, and गण a number.
ग्रहण: ग्रहण mfn. (-णः-णा-णं) A prisoner, captive, confined. 	 n. (-णं) 	 1. Taking, seizure. 	 2. Receiving, acceptance. 	 3. Assent, agreement. 	 4. Respect. 5. The hand. 	 6. An eclipse. 	 7. Comprehension, the taking or receiving of instruction, or the acquirement of any science. 	 8. Sound. 	 9. An organ of sense. 	 10. In grammar, Exception.  E. ग्रह् to take, affix भावे ल्युट्.
ग्रहणान्त: ग्रहणान्त n. (-न्तं) Close of study, acquirement of science, &c.  E. ग्रहण taking, and अन्त end.
ग्रहणान्तिक: ग्रहणान्तिक n. (-कं) Termination of holy study.  E. ग्रहण, and अन्तिक final.
ग्रहणि: ग्रहणि f. (-णिः) 	 1. Diarrhœa, dysentery. 	 2. The vessels diffusing vital warmth. 	 3. The small intestines, that part of the alimentary canal where the bile assists digestion.  E. ग्रह् to seize, अनि Unadi affix; also with ङीप् added ग्रहणी.
ग्रहणीरुज्: ग्रहणीरुज् f. (-रुक्) Diarrhœa, dysentery.  E. ग्रहणी the same (as above), and रुज् sickness, disease.
ग्रहणीय: ग्रहणीय mfn. (-यः-या-यं) To be taken, to be seized, accepted, &c.  E. ग्रह्, and अनीयर् aff.
ग्रहणीहर: ग्रहणीहर n. (-रं) Cloves.  E. ग्रहणी diarrhœa, and हर what removes.
ग्रहनायक: ग्रहनायक m. (-कः) 	 1. The sun. 	 2. The planet Saturn.  E. ग्रह a planet, and नायक a chief.
ग्रहनाश: ग्रहनाश m. (-शः) A planet, (Echites scholaris)  E. ग्रह taking, and नाश injury, producing pain in the bowels, &c. also ग्रहनाशन.
ग्रहनेमि: ग्रहनेमि m. (-मिः) The moon.  E. ग्रह a planet and नेमि the circumference of a wheel, from its shape,
ग्रहपति: ग्रहपति m. (-तिः) The sun.  E. ग्रह a planet. and पति chief.
ग्रहपीडा: ग्रहपीडा f. (-डा) The influence of an unpropitious planet.  E. ग्रह, and and पीडा pain.
ग्रहपुष: ग्रहपुष m. (-षः) The sun,  E. ग्रह, and पुष् to cherish, affix क; cherishing the planets with his light.
ग्रहपूजा: ग्रहपूजा f. (-जा) worship of the sun and the other planets.  E. ग्रह, and पूजा worship.
ग्रहयाग: ग्रहयाग m. (-गा) Worship of or offering to the planets.  E. ग्रह, and याग sacrifice; also ग्रहयज्ञ.
ग्रहयालु: ग्रहयालु mfn. (-लुः-लुः-लु) Taking, receiving.  E. ग्रह to take, आलुच् affix, अय inserted; also गृहयालु,
ग्रहराज: ग्रहराज m. (-जः) 	 1. The sun. 	 2. The moon. 	 3. The planet Jupiter or its regent.  E. ग्रह a planet, and राज a king, a chief.
ग्रहविप्र: ग्रहविप्र m. (-प्रः) An astrologer.  E. ग्रह and विप्र a Brahman.
ग्रहाधार: ग्रहाधार m. (-रः) The constellation DHRUVA or the polar star.  E. ग्रह planet, and आधार asylum; the star remaining fixed amidst the planetary movements.
ग्रहाधीन: ग्रहाधीन mfn. (-नः-ना-नं) Subject to planetary influence.  E. ग्रह, and अधीन dependent.
ग्रहामय: ग्रहामय m. (-यः) Epilepsy, convulsions, demoniac possession which the complaint is supposed to be.  E. ग्रह an imp, and आ मय sickness.
ग्रहाशिन्: ग्रहाशिन् m. (-शी) A plant, (Echites scholaris:) see ग्रहनाश.  E. ग्रह taking, and अश् here meaning to hurt, affix इनि.
ग्रहीतव्य: ग्रहीतव्य mfn. (-व्यः-व्या-व्यं) 	 1. To be taken or accepted. 	 2. To be learned or acquired.  E. ग्रह् to take, तव्य affix, and ई inserted.
ग्रहीतृ: ग्रहीतृ mfn. (-ता-त्री-तृ) Taking, disposed to take.  E. ग्रह् to take, तृच् affix, and ई inserted.
ग्राम: ग्राम m. (-मः) 	 1. A village, a hamlet, an inhabited and unfortified place in the midst of fields and meadow land, where men of the servile class mostly reside, and where agriculture thrives. 	 2. A scale in music. 	 3. (In composition,) A multitude.  E. गम् to go, affix घञ्, and deriv. irr. or ग्रस् to eat, Unadi affix मन् and आच् substituted for the radical final. ग्रस-मन् आदन्तादेशः ।
ग्रामकुक्कुट: ग्रामकुक्कुट m. (-टः) A tame or domestic cock.  E. ग्राम, and क्ककुट a cock.

ग्रामभृत: ग्रामभृत m. (-तः) The village messenger or servant.  E. ग्राम, and भृत sup-ported.

ग्रामवास: ग्रामवास m. (-सः) 	 1. A villager. 	 2. Living in a village.  E. ग्राम, and वास abode; also ग्रामेवास.
ग्रामवासिन्: ग्रामवासिन् m. (-सी) A villager.  E. ग्राम, and वासिन् who inhabits; also ग्रामेवासिन्.
ग्रामविशेष: ग्रामविशेष m. (-षः) Variety of the scales in music.  E. ग्राम, and विशेष dif-ference.

ग्रामहासक: ग्रामहासक m. (-कः) A sister's husband.  E. ग्राम a village, and हास who delights, from हस् to laugh, &c. and ण्वुल् aff. ग्रामं हासयति हम-णिच्. ण्वुल् ।

ग्रामाधिपति: ग्रामाधिपति m. (-तिः) Chief or head of a village.  E. ग्राम, and अधिपति chief.

ग्रामीण: ग्रामीण mfn. (-णः-णा-णं) 	 1. A villager, a rustic. 	 2. Produced in or pecu-liar to a village. 	 3. Vulgar, rude. 4, Chromatic. 	 m. (-णः) 	 1. A dog. 2. A crow. 	 f. (-णा) The indigo plant.  E. ग्राम and खञ् aff.

ग्रामेय: ग्रामेय mfn. (-यः-यी-यं) A villager, rustic, village-born, &c.  E. ग्राम and ढक् affix; also with कन् added ग्रामेयक.
ग्रामेवास: ग्रामेवास m. (-सः) 	 1. A villager. 	 2. A village abode.  E. ग्रामे seventh case, and वास abode.
ग्रामेवासिन्: ग्रामेवासिन् m. (-सी) A villager.  E. ग्रामे seventh case, वासिन् who dwells.
ग्रामेश: ग्रामेश m. (-शः) The head-man of a village.  E. ग्राम and ईश a master.

ग्राम्यधर्म: ग्राम्यधर्म्म m. (-र्म्मः) Copulation. 	 n. ग्राम्य and धर्म्म virtue, village virtue.

ग्राम्यमृग: ग्राम्यमृग m. (-गः) A dog.  E. ग्राम्य and मृग a deer, the village deer; also ग्राममृग.

ग्राम्याश्व: ग्राम्याश्व m. (-श्वः) An ass.  E. ग्राम्य, and अश्व a horse, the village horse.

ग्राहवत्: ग्राहवत् mfn. (-वान्-वती-वत्) Containing or abounding with alligators. E. ग्रह्, and मतुप् aff.
ग्राहिन्: ग्राहिन् mfn. (-ही-हिणी-हि) 	 1. Taking, seizing, accepting, who or what takes. 	 2. Astringent, binding, constipating. 	 m. (-ही) 	 1. A seda-tive, a narcotic. 	 2. The elephant or wood apple: see कपित्थ. 	 f. (-णी) A small kind of Jawasa, perhaps a species of Hedysarum. E. ग्रह् to take, णिनि aff.
ग्राह्य: ग्राह्य mfn. (-ह्यः-ह्या-ह्यं) 	 1. To be seized, to be taken, to be accepted. 	 2. To be accepted as a rule or a law, to be acknowledged or assented to. 	 3. To be attended to or obeyed. 	 4. To be admitted in evidence, &c. 	 5. To be apprehended or arrested.  E. ग्रह् to take, ण्यत् aff.

ग्रैष्म: ग्रैष्म mfn. (-ष्मः-ष्मी-ष्मं) Belonging or relating to, or produced by heat or hot season. of. (-ष्मी) Double jasmin.  E. ग्रीष्म the hot season, &c. affix अण्.
